affiliate.step2Body: Noma ubani ofika ngesixhumanisi sakho unikezelwa kuwe unomphela (okokuqala kuwina, ikhukhi yezinsuku ezingu-90).

workspace.moderationHelp: Nika amandla imvume yokulinganisa kuqala. I-akhawunti kumele ibe ngumdali wokusakaza noma umlinganisi owabelwe kakade. Izindlela zokuvuma nezisajulwa zisasebenza. Izikhathi zokuphela (timeouts) ziphela ngokuzenzakalelayo.
workspace.webhookHelp: Izicelo zokuvuma nokwehluleka kwesenzo kuthumela isaziso esijwayelekile, kanye ngesikhathi esisodwa ngehora. Ayikho imibhalo esajulwa noma imininingwane yesikhwama ethunyelwayo. Shiya kungenalutho ukuze uvale; imiphumela yokulethwa ivela elogini yokucwaninga.
workspace.reversalHelp: Ukuhlehliswa kufihla okuthunyelwe, kususe unomphela amazwana, kubuyisele ukusabela nombhalo wephrofayela, noma kuhlehlise ukulandela okusha. Ukubukwa, izaziso ezilethiwe, okwenziwayo okukhiqiziwe, izithombe zephrofayela nezikhathi zokuphela eziphelelwe yisikhathi azikwazi ukususwa. Okuthunyelwe okufihliwe kuhlala kubuyiseka ezilawulweni zokubonakala kwako.
workspace.confirmCorrection: Lokhu kushintsha umsebenzi oshicilelwe. Ukususwa kwamazwana akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.
workspace.scope: Lezi zilawuli zisebenza emisebenzini ehleliwe, impilo ezimele kanye nabasizi abaxhunyiwe. Okusajulwa kuhlala kuyimfihlo kuze kube yilapho ukugunyaza.

workspace.sample: Umsebenzi nezaziso kuhlanganisa izenzo zakamuva eziyi-100 nemisebenzi engama-200. Izibalo akuzona izibalo zempilo yonke noma ukusetshenziswa kokukhokha.

raffle.title: Imiklomelo
raffle.heroBody: Umklomelo we-DeHub udlulisela amathokheni e-DeHub, i-hardware nezinto zokuqoqa kubantu asebevele besebenzisa inkundla. Ukungena kutholwa ngokubamba iqhaza, uhlu lokungena lushicilelwa ngaphambi kokudonsa, futhi onqobayo ukhethwa ngokuthengiselana noma ubani angafunda.
raffle.noPurchase: Akukho ukuthenga okudingekayo. Ukudweba ngakunye kunendlela yamahhala yokungena, futhi lapho kukhona ithikithi, akulona ukuphela kwendlela yokungena.
raffle.anatomyPrizeBody: Kushiwo lapho ukudweba kuvulwa. Akusoze kwashintshwa kamuva.
raffle.anatomyRoutesBody: Zifakwe kuhlu ngokugcwele, nesisindo esinikezwa yilowo nalowo.
raffle.howBody: Izinyathelo ezine, ngokulandelana okufanayo, njalo. Izingxenye ezinquma ukuthi ubani owinayo zenzeka obala.
raffle.step1Body: Ukudweba ngakunye kuvulwa ngomklomelo wakho, isikhathi sakho sokuvala, nezindlela ezichazayo zokuthola ukungena, okuthunyelwe kuhlelo lokusebenza futhi kunamatheliswe kokudla.
raffle.step2Body: Ukungena kutholwa ngokwenza izinto osuzazi eDeHub. Isimemezelo sibala ukuthi yiziphi izenzo ezibalwa kulokho kudweba nokuthi ukungena ngakunye kubaluleke kangakanani.
raffle.step3Body: Ngesikhathi sokuvala uhlu lokungena luthathwa isithombe-skrini bese kuthathwa inkomba enqobayo emthonjeni wokungahambi kahle ku-chain, hhayi kusuka kuhlu lwezibalo.
raffle.step4Body: Isithombe-skrini, ukuthengiselana, nokungena okunqobayo konke kuya phezulu ndawonye, ​​ngakho-ke noma ubani angabuyekeza umphumela esikhundleni sokukholelwa igama lethu.
raffle.entriesBody: Ukudweba kunikezwe abantu abasebenzisa iDeHub. Isimemezelo ngasinye sibiza izindlela ezibalwa kuso. Lezi yizo izindlela ezidweba ezakhiwa ngazo.
raffle.postBody: Okuthunyelwe, amavidiyo namazwana okuqala kubalwa emidlalweni eyibala.
raffle.stakeBody: Isikhundla sokubeka esivulekile sithola okufakiwe emidlalweni esikukala.
raffle.arcadeBody: Izikhathi ze-Arcade kanye nokubekwa kumabhodi wabaphambili kunikeza imidlalo eyakhelwe emidlalweni.
raffle.stagesBody: Ukuvela eziteji zomsindo ezibukhoma kuyabalwa, noma ngabe ukhuluma noma ulalele.
raffle.ticketBody: Eminye imidwebo iphinde ithengise ithikithi elikhokhwe ngamathokheni e-DeHub. Lapho benza khona, inani nenqwaba yesikhwama ngasinye kushicilelwa kusengaphambili.
raffle.collectibleBody: Imiqoqo ethile ye-NFT iphethe okufakiwe okuhlala njalo emidlalweni eyibala.
raffle.fairnessBody: I-raffle ifanele ukungena kuphela uma umsebenzisi engakwazi ukukhetha ngokuthula owinile. Izinto ezintathu zenza lokho kusebenze lapha.
raffle.fair1Body: Uhlu lokufaka luthwetshulwa ngesikhathi sokuphela esishiwo futhi lushicilelwe ngaphambi kokuthi umdlalo uqale. Akukho lutho olungangezwa kulona kamuva, okuhlanganisa nathi.
raffle.fair2Body: Inkomba yokuwina itholakala ku-chain, ngakho inombolo enquma umdlalo ikhona ekwenzeni okubanzi okungeyona ithuluzi langaphakathi.
raffle.fair3Body: Isithombe, i-transaction hash kanye nokufaka okuwinile kuthunyelwa njengesethi. Ukuphinda ubale izibalo kusuka kudatha yomphakathi kufanele kufinyelele kum winile ofanayo.
raffle.neverPayTitle: I-DeHub ngeke ikucele ukuthi ukhokhe ukuze ukhulule umklomelo
raffle.neverPayBody: Aba winile baqokwa kuhlelo lokusebenza naseposini lomphumela womphakathi. Akekho ku-DeHub ozokuthinta ngemali, isisho sokuqala, ukhiye oyimfihlo noma isignesha yesikhwama ukuze unikele umklomelo. Noma yimiphi imiyalezo enjalo iyinkohliso. Iyibike bese uyisusa.
raffle.faqBody: Lezi esizibuza zona kakhulu mayelana nemidlalo, okufakiwe nemiklomelo.
raffle.faq1Q: Ngidinga ukuthenga yini ukuze ngingene emdlalweni womklomelo we-DeHub?
raffle.faqPurchaseAnswer: Cha. Ukudonsa ngakunye kunendlela yokungena okungenani eyodwa yamahhala, etholwa ngokubamba iqhaza ku-DeHub. Abanye badonsa futhi bathengisa ithikithi elikhokhwe ngamathokheni e-DeHub, kodwa ithikithi alilona ukuphela kwendlela yokungena.
raffle.faq2Q: Ngingazi kanjani ukuthi umdlalo awuzange uqine?
raffle.faq2A: Uhlu lokufaka luthwetshulwa futhi lushicilelwe ngaphambi kokuthi umdlalo uqale, futhi inkomba yokuwina ithathwa emthonjeni wobuhle obuse-chain. Isithombe, i-transaction nokufaka okuwinile kuthunyelwa ndawonye ukuze umphumela uphinde ubale kunoma ubani.
raffle.faq3A: Aba winile baziswa kuhlelo lokusebenza futhi baqokwa eposini lomphumela. Akukho i-imeyili ecela inkokhelo, isisho sokuqala noma isignesha yesikhwama. I-DeHub ngeke icele noma yikuphi kulokhu ukuze ikhulule umklomelo.
raffle.faq4A: Izinsuku ezine kusukela umphumela ushicilelwe. Imiklomelo ye-Token ihlelwa esikhwameni se-DeHub sokuwina ku-Base. Imiklomelo yomzimba ihlelwa ngqo nethimba, futhi ukuthunyelwa kuhlanganiswa lapho singakwazi ukuthumela ngokusemthethweni.
raffle.faq5A: Noma ubani one-akhawunti ye-DeHub oneminyaka engaphezu kwengu-18 futhi ohlala kwenye indawo edonswayo usemthethweni. Izisebenzi ze-DeHub, osonkontileka nemindeni yabo abafaneleki, futhi imidwebo ayinalutho lapho umthetho wendawo ubavimbela khona.
raffle.faq6A: Asikho isheduli engaguquki. Imidwebo ixhunyaniswe nokwethulwa, ingqophamlando nemikhankaso yabalingani, futhi ngayinye imenyezelwa ku-app lapho ivulwa.
raffle.ctaBody: Noma yini ebukhoma manje imenyezelwa ku-feed yakho. Vula izaziso ukuze okulandelayo kungakudlulisi.
raffle.legal: Ukudonswa komklomelo kuyiphromoshini futhi kuvulekele abanikazi be-akhawunti ye-DeHub abaneminyaka engu-18 noma ngaphezulu, akunalutho lapho umthetho wendawo ubavimbela khona. Abasebenzi be-DeHub, osonkontileka nemindeni yabo abafaneleki. Imiklomelo ayinakushintshaniswa ngemali ngaphandle uma kushiwo, futhi isimemezelo somdwebo ngamunye sinemigomo yaso egcwele.

dao.votingPowerNote: Ukuvota kuhlala izinsuku eziyi-7. Amandla okuvota yisamba samathokheni esinikezwe umnikelo ngamunye lapho le ncwadana ivulwa. Okungenani okungu-10% kufanele kuhlanganyele futhi Okwamukelayo kufanele kudlule Okwenqatshelwe.

dao.howItWorksBody: Amandla akho ngumnikelo wakho ohlukaniswe konke okwake kwathunyelwa esikhwameni. Ifundwa ngqo kusuka ku-chain, ayiphelelwa yisikhathi, futhi inquma ukuthi izwi lakho linamandla kangakanani lapho i-DAO ivota ngokuchitha.

screens.freeDmAccessModalDesc: Abasebenzisi abangakuthumelela imiyalezo mahhala, bedlula imali yakho.
screens.glossarySubtitle: Funda ukuthi isithonjana nesici ngasinye kusho ukuthini
screens.glossaryMintTxDesc: Thepha isithonjana solwazi kokuthunyelwe okukhandiwe ukuze uvule ukuthengiselana kokukhanda kwakho ku-block explorer futhi uqinisekise irekhodi elisochungechungeni. Ikhasi eliphelele Lolwazi Lokuthunyelwe — izibalo, abaniniyo, imakethe — likuhlelo lokusebenza lwewebhu ku-dehub.io.
screens.glossaryTokenIdDesc: Isihlonzi esiyingqayizivele esisochungechungeni esinikezwa okuthunyelwe lapho kukhandwa njenge-NFT.
screens.glossaryTipDesc: Thumela ama-tokeni e-DeHub ngqo kumdali wokuqukethwe njengomvuzo ngokuqukethwe kwawo. Amathiphu aqoshwa ku-chain.
screens.glossaryPpvDesc: Okuqukethwe kwe-Premium okudinga ukukhokhelwa ngama-tokeni e-DeHub ukuze kuvulwe. Abadali babeka intengo futhi bahola imali evela ekubukeni ngakunye.
screens.glossaryDhbTokenDesc: I-DHB yisibonakaliso se-ticker sama-tokeni e-DeHub, i-tokeni eyisisekelo ye-DeHub. Isetshenziselwa ukuthumela amathiphu, ukukhokha-ngokubuka-okuqukethwe, ukuvota kwezinhlelo, kanye nokubeka.
screens.glossaryWalletDesc: Isikhwama sakho esiku-chain esiphethe ama-tokeni akho e-DeHub nezinye izimpahla ze-crypto. Ixhumeke nge-Web3Auth ukuze kube lula ukufinyelela.
screens.glossaryStakingDesc: Vala ama-tokeni akho e-DeHub ukuze uzuze imivuzo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ama-tokeni abekiwe nawo akunika amandla okukhulu okuvota ezinhlelweni.
screens.glossaryGovernanceDesc: Hambisa futhi uvote ngeziphakamiso ezibumba inkundla. Amandla akho okuvota anesisindo ngobuningi bama-tokeni e-DeHub owaphethe.
screens.glossaryStakingBadgesDesc: Amabheji abonakala eduze kwegama lakho lomsebenzisi ngokusekelwe kumalungelo akho aphelele we-DeHub tokeni (isikhwama + esibekiwe). Kukhona amazinga angu-13 — lapho uthenga ama-tokeni amaningi, kulapho izinga lakho le-badge liphakeme khona. Amazinga aphezulu anikeza amandla amakhulu okuvota ezinhlelweni kanye nezimali ezincane zenkundla.
screens.glossaryLeaderboardDesc: Abasebenzisi babalwa ngamalungelo aphelele e-DeHub tokeni (isikhwama + abekiwe kuwo wonke ama-chain). Izilinganiso zibuyekezwa ngezikhathi ezithile futhi zilandelwa izinguquko zosuku olungu-1 nosuku olungu-1. Ungakwazi futhi ukuhlunga ngamathiphu athunyelwe, amathiphu atholakele, abalandeli, izintandokazi, noma ababhalisile.

earningsVs.title: Uma kuqhathaniswa namanye amapulatifomu
earningsVs.subtitle: Imali yakho yangempela ye-DeHub uma iqhathaniswa nalokho okubukwa okufanayo obekuzokukhokha kwenye indawo.
earningsVs.estimatorLabel: Akuzona izinombolo zakho? Zama inani lokubukwa noma yiliphi
earningsVs.noteYoutube: Ngemva kwengxenye engu-45% ye-YouTube yemali yezikhangiso. Iyaguquguquka kakhulu ngokwesihloko nezwe lombukeli.
earningsVs.noteTwitch: Imali yezikhangiso kuphela — ayifaki ama-subs nama-bits, okuvamise ukuba yingxenye enkulu.
earningsVs.noteTiktok: I-Creator Rewards. Yaziwa ngokukhokha kancane ngokubukwa ngakunye; isilinganiso yiso sonke isimo.
earningsVs.noteReels: Izinhlelo zebhonasi zimemo kuphela futhi zivaliwe kaningi.
earningsVs.footnote: Izinombolo zabancintisana nazo ziyizilinganiso ezivela ebangeni lomkhakha elishicilelwe, hhayi izinkokhelo ezilinganisiwe — i-RPM yangempela iyahlukahluka kakhulu ngokuya ngendawo ekhethekile, izwe lababukeli kanye nesikhathi sokubuka, ngakho-ke hlela ireyithi ngayinye ukuze ihambisane nalokho okwenzayo ngempela. Isibalo se-DeHub yimali oyitholayo yangempela yokuthinta eguqulwe ngentengo yamathokheni ebukhoma, futhi ayifaki izincwadi, i-PPV kanye nokuthengiswa kwesitolo. Imibono ihlanganiswa kusuka kokuthunyelwe kwakho okungu-100 kwakamuva.

solana.unavailableBody: Le divayisi ayiluphethe ukhiye wesikhwama sakho se-DeHub. Ngena futhi ukuze ubuyisele, nesikhwama sakho se-Solana sibuya naso.
solana.fundingBody: Ukuthumela, ukunikela nokuvula ku-Solana konke kukhokhelwa kusuka kuleli kheli. Thumela i-SOL kulo usuka ku-exchange noma kwesinye isikhwama — cishe i-0.01 SOL yanele okuthunyelwe okuningana. Litholakala esikhwameni sakho se-DeHub, ngakho libuya kunoma iyiphi idivayisi ongena kuyo.
solana.mintingOff: Ukuthumela ku-Solana kuvaliwe kuseva njengamanje. Isikhwama sakho nebhalansi akuthintekile.
solana.legacyBody: Inguqulo yangaphambili yohlelo yakha isikhwama se-Solana esehlukene esasikhona kule divayisi kuphela. Sisenemali. Dlulisela imali kwikheli elingenhla ngenkathi usenale foni — lowo khiye awukwazi ukutholakala kwenye indawo.

walletSetup.tryBiometricsHint: Sebenzisa lokhu uma usethe lesi sikhwama kule foni futhi ukhiye kufanele ukuthi usevele ulapha
walletSetup.restoreMissing: Isikhwama sale phrofayela asikho kule foni, ngakho akukho okungasayinwa okwamanje. Faka umushwana wokubuyisela noma ukhiye wangasese ukuze usilethe lapha.
walletSetup.noPhraseNoKey: Awunayo inkulumo futhi awunalo ukhiye? Lesi sikhwama singavulwa kuphela kudivayisi eyasakha — akukho lutho kuwebhusayithi noma ohlangothini lwethu olungasibuyisa. Ngena kuleyo divayisi uma usenayo.
walletSetup.resetExplainer: Lokhu kunika ukungena kwakho isikhwama esisha ngokuphelele, esingenalutho, futhi kudlulisele i-akhawunti yakho kuso. Akusivuli isikhwama esidala — le foni ayikwazi, i-dehub.io ayikwazi, nathi asikwazi — ngakho noma yini engaphakathi ihlala lapho.
walletSetup.checkingWaysBack: Sihlola ukuthi unayo enye indlela yokubuyela kulesi sikhwama…
walletSetup.couldNotCopy: Ayikwazanga ukukopisha — esikhundleni salokho bhala amagama phansi.
walletSetup.couldNotFinishSetup: Ayikwazanga ukuqeda ukusetha le akhawunti. Sicela uzame futhi.
walletSetup.securingWallet: Sivikela isikhwama sakho — kwamanye amadivayisi lokhu kungathatha kuze kufike kumzuzu owodwa…
walletSetup.unlockingWallet: Sivula isikhwama sakho — kwamanye amadivayisi lokhu kungathatha kuze kufike kumzuzu owodwa…
walletSetup.understandOldWalletA11y: Ngiyaqonda ukuthi isikhwama esidala, nanoma yini ekuso, ngeke kusatholakala
walletSetup.protectWallet: Ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi nguwe kuphela ongathumela noma athenge ngale akhawunti, vikela isikhwama sakho nge-biometrics yedivayisi yakho noma ngephasiwedi.
walletSetup.ifYouUsedDehub: Uma usuke wasebenzisa i-dehub.io ngaphambili, yivule kukhompyutha yakho, ungene ngendlela efanayo nangakhawunti efanayo, bese
walletSetup.biometricExplainer: Vula ngezigxivizo zeminwe noma ubuso bakho — akukho lutho okufanele ulubhale noma ulukhumbule. Ukhiye uhlala kule foni, ngakho sizokukhombisa inkulumo yokubuyisa yamagama angu-12 ozoyibhala phansi; yiyona kuphela indlela yokubuyela ngefoni ehlukile, ngewebhusayithi, noma ngemva kokufaka kabusha. Khetha Iphasiwedi esikhundleni salokho, bese iphasiwedi uqobo yenza lowo msebenzi.
walletSetup.biometricExplainerSecuring: Vula ngezigxivizo zeminwe noma ubuso bakho — akukho lutho okufanele ulubhale noma ulukhumbule. Ukhiye uhlala kule foni. Ukuze ubuyele ngefoni ehlukile, ngewebhusayithi, noma ngemva kokufaka kabusha, gcina isipele samagama angu-12 kamuva ku-Zilungiselelo. Khetha Iphasiwedi esikhundleni salokho, bese iphasiwedi uqobo yenza lowo msebenzi.
walletSetup.biometricPrompt: Lesi sikhwama sivikelwa yi-biometrics yale divayisi. Qinisekisa ngesigxivizo somunwe noma ubuso ukuze uqhubeke.
walletSetup.enterRecoveryPhrase: Faka inkulumo yokubuyisa yamagama angu-12 owayigcina lapho udala lesi sikhwama (noma ukhiye waso oyimfihlo, uma wake wawukhipha). Ibuyela ku-akhawunti efanayo, futhi iphasiwedi oyisetha ngezansi iba yisipele esisebenza yonke indawo kusukela manje.
walletSetup.resetAndCreate: Setha kabusha bese wakha isikhwama esisha
walletSetup.thatsGoneToo: Nalokho kulahlekile — qala kabusha noma kunjalo
walletSetup.confirmStartOver: Qinisekisa ukuthi ufuna ukuqala kabusha ngesikhwama esisha
walletSetup.understandOldWallet: Ngiyaqonda ukuthi isikhwama esidala, nakho konke okukuso, ngeke ngisakwazi ukukuthola naphakade
walletSetup.legacyRecovered: Siqinisekise i-akhawunti yakho endala{{suffix}} futhi sabuyisa isikhwama sayo. Setha iphasiwedi ukuyivikela kule divayisi — kule foni nakuzo zonke ezinye izindawo, kusukela manje.
walletSetup.recoveryRecordNotice: Le akhawunti inerekhodi lokubuyisa recovery record kusuka ku-dehub.io. Ikhodi yokubuyisa yamagama angama-24 oyinikeziwe isavula leli walethi. Vula i-dehub.io kukhompyutha, ungene ngendlela efanayo nangaleyo akhawunti, bese usebenzisa leyo khodi — iletha iwalethi, ne-akhawunti yakho, njengoba zazinjalo.
walletSetup.passkeyNoticeSingle: Le akhawunti inokuvulwa kwe-passkey okubhalisiwe ku-dehub.io. Esipheqululini esiyiphethe, i-dehub.io ingavula leli walethi.
walletSetup.passkeyNoticeMultiple: Le akhawunti inokuvulwa kwe-passkey okungaphezu kokukodwa okubhalisiwe ku-dehub.io. Esipheqululini esiphethe noma yikuphi kuzo, i-dehub.io ingavula leli walethi.
walletSetup.otherWaysCheckFailed: Ayikwazanga ukuhlola ukuthi unezinye izindlela zokubuyela kuleli walethi. Uma wake walungisa ikhodi yokubuyisa noma i-passkey ku-dehub.io, hamba uzame lokho kuqala — ukuqhubeka lapha kuzosula zona.
walletSetup.loseFundsBody: Izilinganiso zayo zihlala ku-{{address}}blockchain — akukho okuchithwayo noma okuthathwayo — kodwa ukuzihambisa kudinga umusho wokubuyisa waleyo walethi noma ukhiye oyimfihlo. Ngaphandle kwawo, akekho ongakwazi ukufinyelela kuwo: hhayi wena, hhayi thina. Ngaphandle kokuthi ukwazi ukukhipha ukhiye kudivayisi eyiwumbayo, phatha lokho okukuyo njengokulahlekile.
walletSetup.loseRecoveryBody: Irekodi lokubuyisa ku-dehub.io lisulwa njengengxenye yalokhu, ngakho-ke leyo ndlela nayo iyavalwa.
walletSetup.loseRecoveryUnknownBody: Uma wake walungisa ikhodi yokubuyisa yamagama angama-24 ku-dehub.io, iyasulwa njengengxenye yalokhu. Asikwazanga ukuhlola ukuthi unayo yini.
walletSetup.losePasskeysBody: Ama-passkey abhaliswe ku-dehub.io asuswa njengengxenye yalokhu.
walletSetup.losePasskeysUnknownBody: Noma yimaphi ama-passkey abhaliswe ku-dehub.io asuswa njengengxenye yalokhu. Asikwazanga ukuhlola ukuthi unayo yini.
walletSetup.keepAccountBody: Igama lomsebenzisi, iphrofayela, okuthunyelwe, ukuphawula, abalandeli, izindondo kanye nomlando konke kuyahamba kuye kule walethi entsha. Kuyi-akhawunti efanayo — akekho okudingeka akutholakale futhi.
walletSetup.keepMessagesBody: Izingxoxo, izaziso, izincwadi, okuthunyelwe okugciniwe nomlando wokubuka kuza nawe. Akukho lutho olusulwayo futhi akekho omunye ongakufunda.
walletSetup.keepSignInBody: Inombolo yocingo efanayo, i-imeyili noma i-akhawunti ye-Google, ukuthepha okukodwa okufanayo. Yileyo walethi engemuva kokungena esikhundleni, hhayi ukungena.
walletSetup.checkDeviceBody: Ifoni igcina ikhophi yayo yokhiye ngenkathi i-DeHub ifakiwe, futhi isiphequluli sigcina i-passkey yaso. Uma usenayo noma yikuphi, hamba lapho, thumela ukhiye oyimfihlo, bese ubuyela lapha bese usebenzisa i-Restore esikhundleni — lokho kugcina nezilinganiso.
walletSetup.passwordBreached: Le phasiwedi ivele ku-data breach — khetha enye ehlukile
walletSetup.phraseInvalidHint: Lokho akuhambisani njengephasiwedi yokubuyisa — amagama ayi-12, ngokulandelana kwawo, wonke angama-lowercase.
walletSetup.privateKeyHint: Ukhiye oyimfihlo ungama-64 wezinhlamvu ze-hex ngemuva kwe-0x.
walletSetup.noUsableBackup: Le akhawunti inekheli lewalethi elingefayeleni, kodwa ayikho isipele leli foni elingasisebenzisa — noma yavalwa nge-biometrics noma i-passkey kuwebhu (lokho kuvulwa kuhlala esipheqululini futhi akuhambisani lapha), noma ukubhalisa kwangaphambili kuleli foni kwaphazamiseka ngaphambi kokuba kuqedwe.
walletSetup.addPasswordOnWeb: Uma wake wazisebenzisa i-dehub.io ngaphambili, yivule kukhompyutha yakho, ungene ngendlela efanayo nangaleyo akhawunti, bese u-engeza iphasiwedi ye-wallet — lokho kugcina isipele esibethelwe efwini. Bese ubuyela lapha bese uzama futhi.
walletSetup.biometricKeepsFailing: {{error}} Uma lokhu kuqhubeka nokuhluleka, sebenzisa iphasiwedi yakho ye-wallet ngezansi noma u-"Ngenisa i-wallet yangaphandle".
walletSetup.deviceBoundKey: Le wallet ivulwa nge-biometrics egcinwe kudivayisi eyodwa ethize — ifoni noma isiphequluli lapho yasetshenziswa khona. Le foni ayinawo lowo okhiye, futhi ne-dehub.io ayinawo: okhiye abaphumi kudivayisi eyawenzayo.
walletSetup.unlockPasskeyOnly: Le wallet yavikelwa nge-passkey kuwebhu futhi ayikabi nayo isipele sephasiwedi efwini. Uma usetha iphasiwedi ye-wallet ku-dehub.io, uyifake lapha — kungenjalo sebenzisa i-Ngenisa i-wallet yangaphandle ngezansi.
walletSetup.unlockWithPasswordExplainer: Le akhawunti isivele inayo i-wallet, evikelwe ngephasiwedi. Yifake ukuze ubuyise i-wallet yakho kule divayisi.
walletSetup.deviceExplainer: Akukho ongakuthayipha noma ukukukhumbula — ukuhlala kokhiye kule divayisi. Sizokunikeza isipele esinamagama angu-12 ukuze usibhale phansi; ukuphela kwendlela yokungena kusuka kwenye idivayisi, kusuka kuwebhusayithi, noma ngemva kokufaka kabusha. Khetha Iphasiwedi kunalokho bese iphasiwedi ngokwayo yenza lowo msebenzi.
walletSetup.deviceExplainerSecuring: Akukho lutho okufanele ulubhale noma ulukhumbule — ukhiye uhlala kule divayisi. Ukuze ubuyele ngenye idivayisi, ngewebhusayithi, noma ngemva kokufaka kabusha, gcina isipele samagama angu-12 kamuva ku-Zilungiselelo. Khetha Iphasiwedi esikhundleni salokho, bese iphasiwedi uqobo yenza lowo msebenzi.

commonGround.title: Umhlaba Ovamile
commonGround.sheetHint: Ikhefu elifushane ngaphambi kokuphendula kwakho. Izimpendulo zakho zihlala ziyimfihlo.
commonGround.toggleHint: Ngaphambi kokuphendula kwabo kokuqala, abafundi bayacelwa iphuzu elinamandla kakhulu kolunye uhlangothi nokuthi bobabili babelana ngani, bese bekhunjuzwa ukuthi bagweme ukucabanga okuthi "noma lokhu noma lokho".
commonGround.banner: Lo mdali uvule imodi Yomhlaba Ovamile. Ngaphambi kokuba uphendule uzocelwa iphuzu elinamandla kakhulu kolunye uhlangothi nokuthi yini eniyihlanganyelayo.
commonGround.step1Title: Ngokomushwana owodwa, yini iphuzu elinamandla kakhulu kolunye uhlangothi?
commonGround.step2Title: Yini enivumelana ngayo wena nabo empeleni?
commonGround.reminderTitle: Qaphela ukucabanga okuthi konke noma akukho lutho
commonGround.reminderBody: Okungavumelani okuningi akukona ukukhetha phakathi kwezinto ezimbili eziphambene. Lapho umbuzo uzwakala sengathi "noma lokhu noma lokho", kuvame ukuba khona inketho yesithathu phakathi.
commonGround.example1: Umakhelwane ofuna umgwaqo othule nokuthi umakhelwane ofuna indawo yokupaka eyengeziwe bangaba nelungelo ngalokho abakudingayo.
commonGround.example2: Abazali ababili bangase bangavumelani ngesikhathi sokusebenzisa izikrini futhi basavumelana ngokuthi ingane kufanele ilele kahle futhi iphumelele esikoleni.
commonGround.noShouting: Izindaba eziyinkimbinkimbi azisoze zahlanganiswa ngokumemeza noma izinsongo. Impendulo ethule, enemininingwane iyona abantu abayifundayo ngempela.
commonGround.privateNote: Izimpendulo zakho zingezakho zodwa futhi azifakwa nempendulo yakho.
commonGround.tooShort: Bhala okungenani izinhlamvu eziyi-10 ukuze ukucabanga kubalwe ngempela.
commonGround.saveFailed: Ayikwazanga ukulondoloza isilungiselelo soMhlaba Ovamile. Sicela uzame futhi.

getting-started.title: Ukuqalisa
getting-started.intro: Kunezindlela ezinhlanu zokungena ku-DeHub futhi akukho neyodwa kuzo edinga ukuthi ube nesikhwama semali kakade: i-Google, i-Apple, ikhodi ethunyelwe ku-imeyili yakho, ikhodi ethunyelwe nge-SMS, noma isikhwama semali esikhona osixhuma. Konke ngaphandle komzila wesikhwama semali kudala isikhwama semali esingagadiwe ngemuva — wena ubamba okhiye, futhi i-DeHub ixhasa igesi ukuze ukwazi ukuthumela, ukunikeza, nokubutha ngaphandle kokuthenga ithokheni lendawo.

steps.1: Vakashela i-dehub.io — okuphakelayo kwasekhaya kuyikhasi elingaphambili, ngakho ungabheka nxazonke ngaphambi kokungena.
steps.2: Chofoza u-'Ngena'. Uzobona i-Google ne-Apple, izinkambu ze-imeyili noma inombolo yocingo, kanye no-'Xhuma Isikhwama Semali' esesikhwameni esikhona.
steps.3: Nge-Google noma i-Apple, qedela inqubo yomhlinzeki. Nge-imeyili noma i-SMS, faka ikhodi efikayo.
steps.4: Isikhwama semali siyadalwa futhi sivikeleke kuwe lapho ungena okokuqala. Ukuxhuma isikhwama sakho semali esikhona esikhundleni sakho kusho isignesha eyodwa ukuze uqinisekise ikheli.
steps.5: Khetha igama lomsebenzisi. Yilokho abantu abakubonayo futhi kuphinda kube isixhumanisi sephrofayela yakho se-dehub.io/<username>.
steps.6: Ungene. Hlola okuphakelayo, setha iphrofayela yakho, bese uqala ukuthumela.

tips.1: Ukungena kwezenhlalo, kwe-imeyili, ne-SMS akukhokhi igesi — i-DeHub iyayixhasa. Izikhwama zemali ezixhunyiwe zikhokha i-ETH noma i-BNB yazo.
tips.2: Ubuyela ku-akhawunti yakudala ye-DeHub? Ngena nge-imeyili noma inombolo yocingo eyayisebenzisa futhi ukufuduka kuyayithola kuwe.
tips.3: Ungagcina ama-akhawunti amaningana kudivayisi eyodwa bese uwashintsha kuzilungiselelo → Iphrofayela.

home-feed.title: Okuphakelayo Kwasekhaya
home-feed.intro: Okuphakelayo kwasekhaya yilapho ubona khona okuthunyelweyo okuvela kubantu obalandelayo nokuqukethwe okudumile. Kusekela amathebhu amaningi ohlobo lokuqukethwe nezinketho zokuhlunga.

steps.1: Zulazula uye ku-/app — lokhu okuphakelayo kwakho kwasekhaya.
steps.2: Sebenzisa amathebhu aphezulu ukuhlunga ngohlobo lokuqukethwe: Ikhaya (konke), Amavidiyo, Izithombe, Ama-Shorts, Umculo, noma Imisakazo Ebukhoma.
steps.3: Swayipha kwesokunxele/kwesokudla kumathebhu ukuze ubone ezinye izinketho kuselula.
steps.4: Sebenzisa inkinobho yokuhlunga/yokuhlela (phezulu kwesokudla kokuphakelayo) ukuze ushintshe ukuhlela: Okushisayo, Okusha, noma Okuphezulu.
steps.5: Donsela phansi ukuze uvuselele okuphakelayo kuselula.
steps.6: Skrola phansi ukuze ulayishe okwengeziwe okuthunyelwe ngokuzenzakalelayo (i-infinite scroll).
steps.7: Shintsha phakathi kokubuka kweGridi nokokuphakelayo usebenzisa isishintshi sokuhlelwa.

tips.1: Ukubuka kweGridi kulungele ukuphequlula izithombe ngokushesha.
tips.2: Thebhu ethi 'Ikhaya' ibonisa zonke izinhlobo zokuqukethwe ezixubile.
tips.3: Thebhu Ebukhoma ibonisa imisakazo ebukhoma esebenzayo njengamanje.

creating-posts.title: Ukwakha Okuthunyelwe
creating-posts.intro: Dala okuthunyelwe kombhalo, yabelana ngezithombe, amavidiyo, amanothi ezwi, ama-GIF, nokuningi. Sebenzisa ama-hashtag, ama-cashtag, namawuphawu ukuze wandise ukufinyelela.

steps.1: Chofoza inkinobho ethi 'Thumela' kubha eseceleni (i-desktop) noma inkinobho + (iselula).
steps.2: Thayipha umbhalo wakho endaweni yokubhala.
steps.3: Ukuze ungeze isithombe noma ividiyo, chofoza isithonjana semidiya bese ukhetha ifayela.
steps.4: Ukuze urekhode inothi lezwi, chofoza isithonjana semakrofoni.
steps.5: Ukuze ungeze i-GIF, chofoza isithonjana se-GIF bese uyifuna.
steps.6: Sebenzisa ama-#hashtag ukuze ukategorise okuthunyelwe kwakho (isb., #crypto, #defi).
steps.8: Sebenzisa ama-@mention ukuze umake abanye abasebenzisi (isb., @username).
steps.9: Chofoza u-'Thumela' ukuze ushicilele. Okuthunyelwe kwakho kuvela kokuphakelayo ngokushesha.

tips.1: Okuthunyelwe kusekela ukuhlelwa okufana ne-markdown.
tips.2: Ungakwazi ukucaphuna okuthunyelwe ngokuchofoza isithonjana sokuthumela kabusha kunoma yikuphi okuthunyelwe bese ukhetha u-'Caphuna'.
tips.3: Izigaba (ama-hashtag) zivela kubhodi yabaphambili ethi 'Inkulumo Yedolobha'.

interacting-with-posts.title: Ukusebenzisana Okuthunyelwe
interacting-with-posts.intro: Zibandakanye nokuqukethwe ngokuvota, ukuphawula, ukunikeza amathiphu, ukubekisa, ukwabelana, nokuhumusha.

steps.1: Votela phezulu noma phansi okuthunyelwe usebenzisa izithonjana zomcibisholo ohlangothini lwesokunxele lwanoma yikuphi okuthunyelwe.
steps.2: Chofoza isithonjana sokuphawula ukuze uvule isigaba sokuphawula bese ushiya impendulo.
steps.3: Chofoza isithonjana segugu/sethiphu ukuze uthumele ithiphu kumathokheni e-DeHub kumdali wokuthunyelwe.
steps.4: Chofoza isithonjana sebhukwana ukuze ugcine okuthunyelwe kamuva.
steps.5: Chofoza isithonjana sokwabelana ukuze ukopishe isixhumanisi sokuthunyelwe noma wabelane ngaphandle.
steps.6: Cindezela inkinobho yokuhumusha (isithonjana seglobhu) kunoma yisiphi isithombe ukuze uhumushe umbhalo olimini lwakho.
steps.7: Kwizithombe, sebenzisa inkinobho ethi 'Translate Image' ukuze uthole inguqulo ehunyushwe yi-AI yombhalo osesithombeni.
steps.8: Cindezela kunoma yisiphi isithombe ukuze usivule kusikrini esigcwele esibonisa isithombe esisodwa.

tips.1: Amathiphu aya ngqo esikhwameni somdali ngama-tokeni e-DeHub.
tips.2: Ungasetha inani le-tip ngezinkinobho zokukhetha ngokushesha noma ufake inani langokwezifiso.
tips.3: Izithombe ezifakwe kumabhukwana zifinyeleleka ekhasini le-Bookmarks kubha yohlangothi.

explore-search.title: Hlola & Sesha
explore-search.intro: Zitholele okuqukethwe okusha nabasebenzisi ngekhasi lokuhlola kanye nomsebenzi wokusesha onamandla.

steps.1: Zulazulela ku-/app/explore kusuka kubha yohlangothi.
steps.2: Sebenzisa ibha yokusesha phezulu ukuze useshe abasebenzisi, izithombe, noma okuqukethwe.
steps.3: Hlunga imiphumela ngethebhu: Konke, Abantu, Izithombe, Izithombe, Amavidiyo, Umculo, Okubukhoma.
steps.4: Dlulisa amehlo ezindikimeni ezidumile nezigaba ekhasini lokuhlola.
steps.5: Cindezela esihlokweni esidumile ukuze ubone zonke izithombe ezihlobene.
steps.6: Cindezela umsebenzisi emiphumeleni yokusesha ukuze uvakashele iphrofayela yakhe.

tips.1: Ukusesha kusekela amagama abasebenzisi, amakheli ezikhwama, namagama angukhiye okuqukethwe.
tips.2: Izindikimba ezidumile zibuyekezwa ngokusekelwe emisebenzini yokuthumela yakamuva.

profile.title: Iphrofayela
profile.intro: Iphrofayela yakho ibonisa izithombe zakho, abalandeli, abalandelayo, nolwazi lwesikhwama sakho.

steps.1: Cindezela i-avatar yakho noma u-'Profile' kubha yohlangothi ukuze ubuke iphrofayela yakho.
steps.2: Cindezela u-'Edit Profile' ukuze ubuyekeze igama lakho lokubonisa, i-bio, kanye ne-avatar.
steps.3: Layisha isithombe sephrofayela ngokucindezela i-avatar yakho kumodi yokuhlela.
steps.4: Buka izibalo zabalandeli bakho nabalandelayo ekhasini lakho lephrofayela.
steps.5: Dlulisa amehlo ezithombeni zakho, imidiya, nokuqukethwe okuthandile ngamathebhu ephrofayela.
steps.6: Kopisha ikheli lesikhwama sakho ngokucindezela isithonjana sokukopisha eduze kwayo.
steps.7: Vakashela amanye amaphrofayela abasebenzisi ngokucindezela igama lomsebenzisi wabo noma i-avatar yabo noma kuphi endaweni yesikhulumi.

tips.1: Igama lakho lomsebenzisi liyingqayizivele futhi livela ku-URL yephrofayela yakho (dehub.io/@username).
tips.2: Izilungiselelo zobumfihlo zikuvumela ukuthi ulawule ukuthi ubani ongabona izibalo zabalandeli bakho.

messages.title: Imilayezo
messages.intro: Thumela imilayezo eqondile kwabanye abasebenzisi endaweni yesikhulumi.

steps.1: Cindezela u-'Messages' kubha yohlangothi ukuze uvule ikhasi lemilayezo.
steps.2: Cindezela inkinobho ethi 'Compose' ukuze uqale ingxoxo entsha.
steps.3: Sesha umsebenzisi ngegama lakhe ukuze umthumelele umlayezo.
steps.4: Bhala umlayezo wakho bese ucindezela u-'Send'.
steps.5: Buka umlando wengxoxo yakho ohlwini lwama-messages.
steps.6: Cindezela engxoxweni ukuze uqhubeke nokuxoxa.

tips.1: Uzothola isaziso lapho othile ekuthumelela umlayezo.
tips.2: Abadali bangakhiya imilayezo ngesidingo sokuthola i-tip.

ai-assistant.title: I-AI Assistant
ai-assistant.intro: Xoxa ne-AI assistant eyakhelwe ku-DeHub ukuze uthole usizo, ulwazi, nemisebenzi yokudala.

steps.1: Cindezela u-'Assistant' ohlangothini ukuze uvule ingxoxo ye-AI.
steps.2: Thayipha umbuzo wakho noma isicelo sakho endaweni yokuthayipha ingxoxo.
steps.3: I-AI ingasiza ngolwazi lwe-crypto, imibuzo ephathelene neplatifomu, nolwazi olujwayelekile.
steps.4: Qala ingxoxo entsha ngokucindezela inkinobho ethi 'New Chat'.
steps.5: Buka umlando wakho wengxoxo ohlangothini lwekhasi le-assistant.
steps.6: Unganamathisela izithombe ukuze i-AI izihlole.

tips.1: I-AI iyakhumbula umongo kungxoxo.
tips.2: Ungabuza i-AI ngezici ze-DeHub, amagama e-crypto, noma imibuzo ejwayelekile.
tips.3: Izingxoxo zangaphambilini zigcinwa futhi zingafinyeleleka nganoma yisiphi isikhathi.

notifications.title: Izaziso
notifications.intro: Hlala unolwazi ngezinto ezifana nama-likes, ukuphawula, ama-tips, ukulandela, neminye imisebenzi kokuqukethwe kwakho.

steps.1: Cindezela isithonjana sewashi noma u-'Notifications' ohlangothini.
steps.2: Buka zonke izaziso ohlwini oluhlelwe ngokulandelana kwesikhathi.
steps.3: Cindezela kusaziso ukuze uye kokuqukethwe okuhlobene naso.
steps.4: Izaziso zihlanganisa: abalandeli abasha, ukuvota okuthunyelwe, ukuphawula, ama-tips, nokukhulunywa ngawe.
steps.5: Izaziso ezingafundiwe zigqanyisiwe — zibhalwa njengefundiwe lapho zibukwa.

tips.1: I-badge yesaziso ikhombisa inani lezaziso ezingafundiwe.
tips.2: Izaziso ze-Tip zikhombisa ukuthi zingaki amathokheni owatholile.

wallet.title: I-Wallet
wallet.intro: Buka izilinganiso zakho zamathokheni e-DeHub kuwo wonke amaketanga, hlola amadiphozithi e-staking, futhi uphathe izimpahla zakho.

steps.1: Cindezela u-'Wallet' ohlangothini ukuze uvule ikhasi le-wallet.
steps.2: Buka ibhalansi yakho yonke yamathokheni ihlanganiswe kuwo wonke amaketanga asekelwayo.
steps.3: Bona ukuhlukana ngeketanga: Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, nokunye.
steps.4: Hlola amadiphozithi akho okubeka kanye nemivuzo.
steps.5: Chofoza u-'Hlaziya kabusha' ukuze ubuyekeze amabhilansi akho kusuka kudatha ye-on-chain.
steps.6: Kopisha ikheli lakho le-wallet ukuze uthole amathokheni kubanye.

tips.1: Amabhilansi abuyekezwa ngokuzenzakalelayo kodwa ungakwazi ukuphoqelela ukuhlaziya kabusha nganoma yisiphi isikhathi.
tips.2: I-wallet ikhombisa amabhilansi angamanzi (atholakalayo) nawokubeka.

staking.title: Ukubeka
staking.intro: Beka amathokheni akho e-DeHub ukuze uzuze imivuzo futhi wandise amandla akho okuvota ohulumeni.

steps.1: Zulazulela ekhasini elithi 'Ukubeka' kusuka kubha yesigaba.
steps.2: Faka inani lamathokheni ongathanda ukuwabeka.
steps.3: Khetha iketanga ongathanda ukulibeka kulo.
steps.4: Qinisekisa ukuthengiselana ku-wallet yakho (amawalllet angaphandle) noma kwenzeka ngokuzenzakalelayo (ukungena ngemvume komphakathi).
steps.5: Buka izimali zakho ezibekiwe nanoma yimiphi imivuzo elindile.
steps.6: Ukukhipha, faka inani bese uqinisekisa ukuthengiselana kokukhipha.

tips.1: Ukubeka kwandisa isisindo sakho sokuvo eziphakamisweni zikahulumeni.
tips.2: Abasebenzisi bokungena ngemvume komphakathi akudingi igesi ukuze babeke - akudingi igesi.

leaderboard.title: Ibhodi yabaphambili
leaderboard.intro: Bona ukuthi ubani osengaphezulu! Ibhodi yabaphambili ihlunga abasebenzisi ngebhalansi, ukuchitha kwansuku zonke, nezingqikithi ezishisayo.

steps.1: Zulazulela ekhasini elithi 'Ibhodi yabaphambili' kusuka kubha yesigaba.
steps.2: Shintsha phakathi kwamathebhu: Ibhalansi, Okuchithwe Nsuku zonke, kanye Nengxoxo Yedolobha.
steps.3: Ithebhu ye-Ibhalansi ihlunga abasebenzisi ngezimali zabo zamathokheni.
steps.4: Ithebhu Yokuchitha Kwansuku zonke ikhombisa ukuthi ubani obelokhu esebenza kakhulu ekunikezeni amathiphu emahoreni angu-24 adlule.
steps.5: Ingxoxo Yedolobha ikhombisa izingqikithi/izigaba ezixoxwa kakhulu.
steps.6: Chofoza kunoma yimuphi umsebenzisi ukuze uvakashele iphrofayela yakhe.
steps.7: Ibhodi yabaphambili ibuyekezwa ngezikhathi ezithile usuku lonke.

tips.1: Izilinganiso zansuku zonke ziqala kabusha njalo emahoreni angu-24.
tips.2: Ingxoxo Yedolobha ilandelela izigaba zamagama ayisihloko kusuka kuma-hashtag.

command-centre.title: Isikhungo Semiyalezo
command-centre.intro: Isikrini esibonisa izinto ezibalulekile zakho nomsebenzi weplathifomu shazi.

steps.1: Chofoza ku-'Command Centre' ohlangothini.
steps.2: Buka isifinyezo sephrofayela yakho, okuhlanganisa inani lezikhundla, abalandeli, nokuzibandakanya.
steps.3: Bona umsebenzi wakho wakamuva nezihloko ezithrendayo.
steps.4: Finyelela izixhumanisi ezisheshayo ezisebenzini ezisetshenziswa njalo.

tips.1: I-Command Centre ikunikeza umbono obanzi wobukhona bakho ku-DeHub.

governance.title: Ukuphatha
governance.intro: Bamba iqhaza ekuphathweni kweplathifomu ngokudala iziphakamiso nokuvota ezinqumweni zomphakathi.

steps.1: Zulazulela ku-'Governance' ohlangothini.
steps.2: Dlulisa amehlo eziphakamisweni ezisebenzayo ezithunyelwe umphakathi.
steps.3: Chofoza esiphakamisweni ukuze ufunde incazelo yaso egcwele nengxoxo.
steps.4: Vota eziphakamisweni usebenzisa izinkinobho zokudumisa/ukugxeka — isisindo sakho sokuvota sincike enanini lamathokheni e-DeHub owafake isitaki.
steps.5: Shintsha imibono eziphakamisweni ukuze uxoxe nomphakathi.
steps.6: Thumela isiphakamiso sakho ngokuchofoza inkinobho ethi 'Create Proposal'.

tips.1: Amandla akho okuvota anqunywa inani lamathokheni owafake isitaki.
tips.2: Abaphethe amabheji bangase bathole isisindo sokuvota esingeziwe.

bookmarks.title: Amabhukwana
bookmarks.intro: Gcina izikhundla kumabhukwana akho ukuze uzifinyelele kalula kamuva.

steps.1: Chofoza isithonjana sebhukwana kunoma yisiphi isikhundla ukuze usigcine.
steps.2: Zulazulela ku-'Bookmarks' ohlangothini ukuze ubuke zonke izikhundla ezigciniwe.
steps.3: Chofoza isikhundla esibekwe ebhukwana ukuze usibuke sigcwele.
steps.4: Susa ibhukwana ngokuchofoza isithonjana sebhukwana futhi.

tips.1: Amabhukwana ayimfihlo — wena wedwa ongabona izikhundla zakho ezigciniwe.
tips.2: Akukho mkhawulo enanini lezikhundla ongazibeka ebhukwana.

settings.title: Izilungiselelo
settings.intro: Enza ngendlela oyifisayo isipiliyoni sakho se-DeHub ngezintandokazi zolimi, ubumfihlo, nokuboniswa.

steps.1: Chofoza ku-'Settings' ohlangothini.
steps.2: Shintsha ulimi lwakho lokuboniswa kusuka kusikhethi solimi.
steps.3: Lungisa izilungiselelo zobumfihlo: lawula ukuthi ubani obona izibalo zabalandeli bakho nohlu lwabalandelayo.
steps.4: Setha okukhethwayo kwakho okuzenzakalelayo kokubonakala kokuthunyelwe.
steps.5: Phatha izintandokazi zezaziso.

tips.1: I-DeHub isekela izilimi eziningi — yonke imenyu iyaguqulelwa.
tips.2: Izilungiselelo zobumfihlo zisebenza ngokushesha.

posting-allowance.title: Umkhawulo Wakho Wansuku zonke Wokuthumela
posting-allowance.intro: Ukuthumela kumahhala nsuku zonke kuze kufike kumkhawulo ohambisana nebheji yakho yokubeka. Wonke umuntu uqala ngeposi eyishumi lombhalo kanye ne-gigabyte eyodwa yevidiyo, izithombe nomsindo ngosuku. Dlula kunoma iyiphi yazo bese okunye kwalolo suku kukhokhelwa ngamathokheni e-DeHub — kuphela engxenyeni edlula umkhawulo.

steps.1: Thumela njengenjwayelo. Ngaphakathi komkhawulo akukho lutho olukhokhiswayo futhi akukho lutho olucelwa kuwe.
steps.2: Amaposi ombhalo nemidiya kungamachibi ahlukene, ngakho usuku oluchithwe ukulayisha ividiyo kusasele wonke amaposi ombhalo ayishumi mahhala.
steps.3: Lapho iposi lingadlula umkhawulo, uhlelo lokusebenza luyibiza kuqala futhi luhlola ukuthi isikhwama sakho singayihlanganisa yini ngaphambi kokuthi kukhishwe noma yini.
steps.4: Iposi lishicilelwa njengoba bekuzokwenzeka ngaphakathi komkhawulo — ukushicilela akulokothi kulinde inkokhelo.
steps.5: Bese uvuma ukudluliswa okukodwa kwalolo poshi kuphela, okuxazululwe kunoma iyiphi i-Base noma i-BNB Chain enenani elanele lamathokheni e-DeHub.
steps.6: Amachibi omabili abuyela phansi phakathi kwamabili UTC.

tips.1: Ukudlula komkhawulo kulinganiselwe: 200 MB ngaphezu komkhawulo wakho kubiza u-200 MB, hhayi i-gigabyte ephelele.
tips.2: Ukuphinda uthumele, ukuphawula, ukusabela, amathiphu nemilayezo akubizi lutho futhi akuthinti umkhawulo.
tips.3: Yenqaba inkokhelo futhi iposi lihlala likhona — inani nje livimba iposi lakho elikhokhelwayo elilandelayo kuze kube yilapho selixazululwe. Umkhawulo wamahhala wangakusasa ungowakho njalo.
tips.4: I-bheji yokubeka yandisa umkhawulo wamahhala futhi yehlisa intengo yanoma yini edlula kuwo.

reactions-and-safety.title: Izimpawu zokubuyekeza, Ukuthulisa Nokuqukethwe Okudala
reactions-and-safety.intro: Kunezimpawu zokubuyekeza eziyisishiyagalolunye ngemuva kwenkinobho ethi "like", kanye nesethi yezilawuli zokunquma ukuthi ubona ini nokuthi ubani ongakufinyelela.

steps.1: Bamba isithupha esikhombisa phezulu kunoma yikuphi iposi ukuze uvule ithreyi lezimpawu zokubuyekeza: njengokuthanda, uthando, ukuhlonipha, ukushisa, lol, ukudabuka, ukukhala, ukungathandi kanye nenkunkulu.
steps.2: Izimpawu zokubuyekeza eziyisikhombisa ezinhle zibala esibalweni samalikesi eposi; ukungathandi nenkunkulu kubala ngokumelene nakho.
steps.3: Impumelelo yakho ihambisana nebheji yakho yokubeka, ngakho impendulo yomnikazi webheji ihambisa isibalo kude kunevoti elilodwa.
steps.4: Thepha u-X kuhlaka lweposi ukuze uthulise umbhali walo — bayanyamalala ohlwini lwakho ngokushesha.
steps.5: Abadali baphawula amaposi abo njengawadala lapho bewadala; lawo maposi ahlala kude nohlu oluvamile lwasekhaya.
steps.6: Ukubona amaposi adala yonke indawo, vula u-'Bonisa okuqukethwe okudala' kuzilungiselelo.

tips.1: Iposi elidala lisabonakala ngokugcwele kuphrofayela yomdali kanye nabantu ababalandelayo.
tips.2: Ukuvimba kusuka kuphrofayela kudlula ukuthulisa futhi kuvala nemilayezo.
tips.3: Ithreyi lezimpawu zokubuyekeza libonisa ukuthi ubani ophendule futhi ngeyini, ngakho ungabona igumbi kunokuba ubone inombolo nje.

stages.title: Izigaba (Amagumbi Okulalelwayo Aphilayo)
stages.intro: Izigaba amagumbi okulalelwayo aphilayo akhelwe ku-DeHub. Umphathi uvula igumbi, alethe izipikha, futhi noma ubani angangena ukulalela kusuka ekhasini lezigaba noma isixhumanisi esabiwe.

steps.1: Vula u-'Stages' kubha yohlangothi ukuze ubone ukuthi yini ephila manje nokuthi yini ehleliwe.
steps.2: Themba isigaba esibukhoma ukuze ujoyine njengomlaleli, noma setha isikhumbuzi esihleliwe futhi waziswe lapho siqala.
steps.3: Qala esakho ekhasini elifanayo — ungaya ebukhoma ngqo kusuka kusiphequluli, ngaphandle kwe-OBS noma ukhiye wokusakaza.
steps.4: Njengomphathi, yisa izipikha esigabeni, uzithulise noma uzisuse, yabelana ngesikrini sakho, futhi ulawule ibhodi lemisindo.
steps.5: Ababukeli bathumela izimpendulo ezibukhoma futhi bakhulume engxoxweni yegumbi ngaphandle kokungena esigabeni.
steps.6: Isigaba ngasinye siqopha, futhi irekhodi lidlala kamuva kusuka ekhadini elivelayo kulo.

tips.1: Imibhalo engezansi ebukhoma ibhala isipikha ngasinye futhi ihumusha kunoma yiluphi ulimi olufundayo.
tips.2: Ukuhumusha okubukhoma kungakhuluma igumbi ngokuzwakalayo ngezwi lomphathi eliklonjiwe, elikhokhiswa ngomzuzu ngamathokheni e-DeHub.
tips.3: Abaphathi bangabeka isiteshi somsakazo emoyeni noma badlale iziqeshana zabo zomculo phakathi kwezingxoxo.
tips.4: Isidlali esincane sigcina igumbi liqhubeka ekhoneni ngenkathi upheqa okunye kuhlelo lokusebenza.

communities.title: Imiphakathi & Imicimbi
communities.intro: Imiphakathi yizikhala eziqhutshwa amalungu ezinezindaba zazo, amalungu nomsebenzi. Imicimbi ingeza uhlelo oluboshelwe isikhathi phezu kwazo.

steps.1: Vula 'Imiphakathi' kubha eseceleni bese upheqa lezo zomphakathi.
steps.2: Joyina ngokuthepha okukodwa. Umsebenzi omusha ubonakala njengophawu olungafundiwe kunavigasyon.
steps.3: Thumela, xoxisana, phatha amavoti futhi uthumele ngaphakathi kwezindaba zomphakathi.
steps.4: Abanikazi bomphakathi balawula izikhala zabo futhi bangabanika abanye amalungelo okuphatha.
steps.5: Vula 'Imicimbi' ukuze uhlele izinhlelo ezihleliwe, ngohlelo olugcwele lomcimbi ngamunye ongalandela bukhoma.

tips.1: Ingxoxo yomphakathi isekela @mentions kanye @here, ngakho-ke okuthunyelwe kungafinyelela egumbini.
tips.2: Isixhumanisi isimemo sikuvumela ukuthi ulethe abantu ngqo emphakathini.

arcade.title: I-Arcade
arcade.intro: Imidlalo emihlanu idlala ngaphakathi kwe-DeHub kuthebhu yesiphequluli — akukho okufanele kufakwe, akukho okufanele kuthengwe.

steps.1: Vula 'I-Arcade' kubha eseceleni.
steps.2: Khetha umdlalo: King's Gambit (i-chess ye-3D enomugqa we-Elo online), Claude of Duty (isidubuli esakha ubuciko sayo njengoba ilayisha), Jungle Trail (uhambo lwehlathi elenziwe ngendlela), Street Slayer (i-beat 'em up eyenziwe nge-DeHub) noma i-Chartopia (indawo yokuhweba engahamba).
steps.3: Dlala kuthebhu. I-King's Gambit ne-Street Slayer zigcina amabhodi wabaphambili.
steps.4: I-Chartopia iphinde idlale kusibonisi se-VR nge-WebXR.

tips.1: Ezimbili zazo zifihle ngaphakathi kwezindikimba zokubukeka — setha uhlelo lokusebenza ku-War ye-Claude of Duty, noma i-Jungle ye-Jungle Trail.
tips.2: Umdlalo ngamunye unekhadi lawo lokwabelana, ngakho-ke isixhumanisi esinye siyavuleka kahle noma ngabe usithumela kuphi.

bounties-stores.title: Ama-Bounty & Izitolo
bounties-stores.intro: Izindlela ezimbili zokuguqula inkundla ibe yimali engenayo: thumela noma ufune i-bounty, noma uvule isitolo futhi uthengise kubabukeli bakho.

steps.1: Vula 'Ama-Bounty' ukuze upheqa umsebenzi ovulekile, uhlungwe ngesigaba noma ngemali.
steps.2: Funa eyodwa, yenza umsebenzi, bese uyithumela ukuze uthole umklomelo — noma ngubani angaba umzingeli, akukho isicelo esidingekayo.
steps.3: Thumela i-bounty yakho siqu nge-brief kanye nomvuzo kuma-DeHub tokens noma i-USDC. Ingena ku-escrow ngomzuzu owuthumela.
steps.4: Vula 'Izitolo' ukuze usethe indawo yokuthengisa enayo ikhasi layo, i-branding, kanye nezinhlu.
steps.5: Imikhiqizo inamanani futhi ihlelwa kuma-DeHub tokens nge-wallet eyakhelwe ngaphakathi, ngaphandle kokukhokha kwangaphandle.

tips.1: Ama-Bounty ahlukaniswe abe ku-Social Media, Clipping, kanye ne-Contracts.
tips.2: Inqubo yokuphikisana ihlela ukungavumelani ngokulethwa, ngakho-ke i-escrow ihlale ixazululwa ngokufanele.
tips.3: Abadali basebenzisa ama-bounty ukukhulisa umphakathi — ukwabelana, iziqeshana, kanye nokuphendula konke kuyimisebenzi evumelekile.

creator-studio.title: I-Creator Studio & Editor
creator-studio.intro: I-Creator Studio ikhiqiza izithombe, ividiyo, umculo, izwi, kanye namamodeli we-3D kusuka ku-prompt, futhi iyinikeze kumhleli — okuhlanganisa isihleli sevidiyo esigcwele esiningi esisebenza kusiphequluli.

steps.1: Vula i-Creator Studio bese uchaza ukuthi ufuna kwenziwe.
steps.2: Iseva icaphuna izindleko ngaphambi kokuthi umsebenzi uqale, ngakho-ke ubona ukuthi ubiza malini ngaphambi kokuthi usebenzise.
steps.3: Ama-Render aqhubeka kumugqa wokulinda ohlanganyelwe ngenkathi uqhubeka nokuphequlula uhlelo lokusebenza.
steps.4: Hlela imiphumela kusihleli esifana ne-Canva, noma vula isihleli sevidiyo ukuze uthole isikhathi sangempela ngokunquma, ukubeka ungqimba, nokuthekelisa.
steps.5: Lahla isiqeshana esiqediwe ngqo kokuthunyelwe, okufushane, noma uhlu lwesitolo.

tips.1: Umtapo wezimpahla zamahhala ezihleliwe uhlala eduze kwe-Studio nganoma yini ongathanda ukuyikhiqiza.
tips.2: Ukukhiqiza kukhokhelwa ngama-DeHub tokens kusuka ku-wallet yakho — usayina ukudluliselwa okukodwa komsebenzi ngamunye, futhi intengo icashwa ngaphambi kokuthi ukhokhe.
tips.3: Abasebenzisi abaningi bangathatha uhlelo lwe-Ultra, Team, noma Scale, oluthumela imali yethokheni yanyanga zonke ngqo ku-wallet yabo.

buying-dhb.title: Ukuthenga Amathokheni
buying-dhb.intro: Thenga ama-DeHub tokens ngqo ngaphakathi kohlelo lokusebenza usebenzisa isixhumi esibonakalayo sokushintshanisa esakhelwe ngaphakathi.

steps.1: Zulazulela ekhasini elithi 'Thenga' kusuka kubha yohlangothi.
steps.2: Khetha ithokheni ofuna ukuyishintshanisa kulo (isb., ETH, USDC).
steps.3: Faka inani ofuna ukulisebenzisa noma inani lamathokheni ofuna ukuwathola.
steps.4: Buyekeza izinga lokushintshanisa kanye nomphumela olinganiselwe.
steps.5: Chofoza isithonjana segiya lezilungiselelo ukuze ulungise ukubekezelelana kokushelela (okuzenzakalelayo ngu-1%).
steps.6: Qinisekisa ukuthengiselana kokushintshanisa.
steps.7: Ama-DeHub tokens azovela ku-wallet yakho lapho ukuthengiselana kuqeda.

tips.1: Ukubekezelelana okuphezulu kokushelela = kungenzeka ukuthi kufezeke, kodwa kungenzeka kube nokubuyekezwa okubi kakhulu.
tips.2: Hlola njalo izinga lokushintshanisa ngaphambi kokuqinisekisa.
tips.3: Ungasetha ukushelela okwenziwe ngendlela oyifisayo kuphaneli yezilungiselelo.

bridge.title: Ibuloho
bridge.intro: Hambisa ama-DeHub tokens akho phakathi kwamabhulokhi asekelwayo usebenzisa ibuloho le-cross-chain.

steps.1: Zululela ekhasini elithi 'Bridge' kusuka kubha yesisombululo.
steps.2: Khetha uchungechunge lomthombo (lapho izimpawu zakho zikhona khona njengamanje).
steps.3: Khetha uchungechunge lapho uya khona (lapho ufuna ukuzithumela khona).
steps.4: Faka inombolo yezimpawu ongazidlulisa.
steps.5: Buyekeza imali yokudlulisa nesikhathi esilinganiselwe sokufika.
steps.6: Qinisekisa ukuthengiselana kokudlulisa.
steps.7: Ithimba lithumela amathokheni ku-chain okuyiwa kuyo, ngokuvamile phakathi kwezinsuku zomsebenzi ezi-1-5.

tips.1: Izimali zokudlulisa ziyahlukahluka ngombhangqwana weketango.
tips.2: Okwamanje, izinkokhelo zebhuloho zenziwa ngesandla.
tips.3: Hlola njalo uchungechunge lapho uya khona ngaphambi kokuqinisekisa.

music-tv.title: Umculo ne-TV
music-tv.intro: Jabulela okuqukethwe kwemidiya ngqo ngaphakathi kwe-DeHub — sakaza umculo futhi ubuke iziteshi ze-TV ezibukhoma.

steps.1: Zululela ku-'Music' kusuka kubha yesisombululo ukuze uphequlule futhi udlale okuthunyelwe komculo.
steps.2: Zululela ku-'TV' ukuze ufinyelele iziteshi ze-TV ezibukhoma.
steps.3: Phelezelisa iziteshi ngezigaba noma izwe.
steps.4: Chofoza kusiteshi ukuze uqale ukubuka.
steps.5: Sebenzisa izilawuli zesidlali ukuze ulungise ivolumu nokudlala.
steps.6: Bika iziteshi ezilimele usebenzisa inkinobho yokubika.

tips.1: Iziteshi ze-TV ziqinisekiswe umphakathi ukuze ziqine.
tips.2: Okuthunyelwe komculo kungadlalwa ngenkathi uphequlula okunye okuqukethwe.

post-info.title: Ulwazi Lokuthunyelwe Nezabelo
post-info.intro: Okuthunyelwe okukhiqiziwe kuyi-NFT ehlukaniswe izabelo eziyi-1,000. Ikhasi Lolwazi Lokuthunyelwe libonisa idatha ku-chain, izibalo zokuzibandakanya, ukuhlukana kobunikazi, futhi likuvumela ukuthi uhwebe izabelo zanoma yikuphi okuthunyelwe — okuthunyelwe okungakhiqiziwe kunikeza ukukhiqiza esikhundleni salokho.

steps.1: Thepha isithonjana esithi 'ⓘ' kunoma yikuphi okuthunyelwe ukuze uvule ikhasi Lwazi Lokuthunyelwe.
steps.2: Phezulu uzobona i-Token ID (isihlonipho esiyingqayizivele ku-chain) kanye ne-transaction hash — chofoza i-hash ukuze uyibuke ku-block explorer.
steps.3: Ngaphansi kwalokho, izibalo zokuzibandakanya zibonisa inani eliphelele lokuthandayo, ukungathandi, ukubukwa, ukuphawula, namathiphu atholiwe.
steps.4: Isigaba Sabanikazi sibonisa ibha yenqubekela phambili yokuthi zingaki ezingu-1,000 izabelo umdali asaziphethe, kanye nohlu lwabo bonke abanikazi bezabelo ngezinga labo namaphesenti abo.
steps.5: Uma okuthunyelwe kungukukhokha-ngokubuka (PPV), uzobona intengo, uhlobo lwemali, nokuthi bangaki abasebenzisi abathenge ukufinyelela.
steps.6: Abanikazi bokuthunyelwe bangashintsha ukubonakala (Umphakathi, Okungafakiwe, noma Okuyimfihlo) futhi bahlele isihloko/incazelo ngqo kusuka kuleli khasi.

tips.1: Okuthunyelwe okukhiqizwe muva nje kuqala nomdali ephethe zonke izabelo eziyi-1,000 (ubunikazi obungu-100%).
tips.2: I-transaction hash ixhuma ku-BaseScan noma i-BscScan kuye ngamaketango.
tips.3: Izikhundla ezingafakiwe zivela ezifuneni kodwa zingafinyeleleka ngesixhumanisi esiqondile.

trading-fractions.title: Izingxenyana Zokuhweba
trading-fractions.intro: Ukuhweba ngezingxenyana — ukubhrawuza izindlu, ukwenza izaphulelo, ukufaka eyakho indlu — kuphila ku-app yewebhu ku-dehub.io, ekhasini ngalinye le-Post Info lephosti.

steps.1: Vula i-dehub.io kubhrawuza bese ungena ngemvume nge-akhawunti efanayo.
steps.2: Vula ikhasi lemininingwane yephosti bese ushintshela kuthebhu yayo ye-Marketplace.
steps.3: Bhrawuza izindlu, yenza isaphulelo ngenani lakho, noma faka izingxenyana ozibambile.
steps.4: Uma ukuhweba sekuqedile, ushintsho luvela kuthebhu yakho ethi Izingxenyana lapha kumakhalekhukhwini.

tips.1: Ukuba nezingxenyana zephosti kusho ukuthi unengxenye yaleyo NFT.
tips.2: Hlola abanikazi bephosti emakethe yewebhu ukuze ubone ukusatshalaliswa kobunikazi ngaphambi kokuthenga.
tips.3: Njengomsunguli, ukuthengisa izingxenyana kuvumela abalandeli ukuba bamukele okusunguliwe kwakho.

minting-posts.title: Ukuminta Izikhundla (Ukwakha ama-NFT)
minting-posts.intro: Ukuminta ngokuzikhethela. Isikhundla sishicilelwa ngaphandle kwekhono ngesikhathi usithumela — akukho isikhwama, akukho ssign, akukho gas — futhi ungakwazi ukusiminta njenge-NFT noma nini lapho ufuna, noma ngenkathi uyibhala noma kamuva kusuka esikhundleni ngokwaso.

steps.1: Chofoza inkinobho ethi 'Post' kubha yezinhlangothi (idessktop) noma inkinobho ethi + (iselula).
steps.2: Bhala umbhalo wakho, namathisela imidiya (izithombe, amavidiyo, umsindo), bese wengeza izigaba.
steps.3: Shintsha 'Mint post' ukuze ushicilele ngaphandle kwekhono, noma uyivule ukuze uyiminte ngenkathi ushicilela.
steps.4: Ukushicilela akulindi ochungechungeni: iphosti ivela ku-feed nganoma iyiphi indlela.
steps.5: Ukuze uxove kamuva, vula ikhasi lemininingwane lephosti elithi '¢' bese usebenzisa isenzo se-Mint lapho.
steps.6: Uma usuqoshiwe, iphosti ithola i-Token ID ne-hash yemali engenayo nephumayo ongayiqinisekisa ku-chain, futhi ubamba zonke izingxenyana zayo ezingu-1,000.

tips.1: Ukungena ngemvume kwezenhlalo, i-imeyili ne-SMS kukhokha igesi engekho — Abaxhasi be-DeHub bakhokha izimali zokusungula.
tips.2: Abasebenzisi besikhwama bangaphandle badinga i-ETH ku-Base NOMA ku-BNB KU-BNB Chain yegesi.
tips.3: Ukuphawula yilokho okwenza iphosti idayiseke futhi ibe nemithwalo yasebukhosini. Iphosti engashicilelwe isathola amacebiso nokubukwa.
tips.4: Irekhodi eliku-chain lihlala unomphela uma selidwetshiwe, ngisho noma iphosti isuswa kamuva ku-feed.

glossary.title: Uhlu lwamagama
glossary.intro: Uhlu lwezincazelo oluphelele lwe-crypto namagama enkundla ukukusiza ukuthi uhambe ngeWebhu3.

steps.1: Iya ku- 'Glossary' kusuka kubha eseceleni.
steps.2: Bhrawuza amagama alfabhethi noma usebenzise usesho ukuze uthole amagama athile.
steps.3: Chofoza igama ukuze ubone incazelo yalo egcwele nencazelo.
steps.4: Imigomo ihlanganisa imiqondo ye-crypto, amagama e-DeFi, nezici eziqondene ne-DeHub.

tips.1: Insiza enhle yabafikayo ku-crypto naku-Web3.
tips.2: Uluhlu lwamagama luvuselelwa njalo ngemigomo emisha.

creatorPacks.title: Amaphakethe
creatorPacks.subtitle: Ama-emoji, izitika nama-GIF enziwe abanikazi bamabheji. Faka noma yiliphi iphakethe kumkhethi wakho bese ulisebenzisa ezingxoxweni, kumazwana nokusabela.
creatorPacks.emptyStickers: Awekho amaphakethe ezitika okwamanje. Yidale nge-badge, noma faka eyomunye umuntu.
creatorPacks.lockedBody: Beka i-amathokheni ukuze uthole ibheji ukuze udale amaphakethe akho ama-emoji, izitika nama-GIF. Izinga eliphezulu lithola amaphakethe engeziwe nendawo eyengeziwe kuwo wonke.
creatorPacks.yourTier: Ibheji ye-{{tier}}: amaphakethe angu-{{packs}} ohlobo ngalunye, kufika kuma-emoji angu-{{emoji}}, izitika ezingungu-{{stickers}} noma ama-GIF angu-{{gifs}} kuwo wonke.
creatorPacks.tierTableHint: Amaphakethe angawohlobo ngalunye. Amakholomu amanye achaza ukuthi zingaki izinto ezilingana ephaketheni elilodwa. Uma izinga lakho lehla, amaphakethe akho ahlala khona kodwa awukwazi ukufaka ngaphezu kwemikhawulo emisha.
creatorPacks.uploadHint: I-PNG, i-GIF, i-WebP noma i-JPEG kuze kufike ku-2 MB ngamunye. Ungakhetha eziningana ngesikhathi esisodwa.
creatorPacks.uploadHintGif: I-GIF, i-PNG, i-WebP noma i-JPEG kuze kufike ku-8 MB ngamunye. Ungakhetha eziningana ngesikhathi esisodwa.

multiPost.title: Ukuthumela okuningi
multiPost.intro: Thumela ku-X, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok nakwezinye ngesikhathi esisodwa nge-dehub. Xhuma ama-akhawunti akho kanye, bese ukhetha ukuthi i-post ngayinye iya kuphi.
multiPost.loadFailed: Ayikwazanga ukulayisha ukuthumela okuningi. Zama futhi maduze.
multiPost.platformNotes: I-YouTube idinga ividiyo. I-Instagram, i-TikTok, i-Pinterest ne-Snapchat kudinga isithombe noma ividiyo. I-Instagram kumele ibe i-akhawunti yeBhizinisi noma yeCreator. Ama-post e-TikTok aphuma emphakathini anamazwana, ama-duet nama-stitch avuliwe.

depin.title: DePin
depin.noFixedRate: Akukho mali esethiweyo, inzuzo encinci, i-APY okanye isilinganiselo sangaphambili. Amarekhodi egosa yimfuno yokubala kuphela, hayi isithembiso sokuhlawulwa. Nakuphi na ukuhlawulwa kwe-token okuzayo kuya kwenzeka kwi-Base kwaye kuhlala kuxhomekeke ekufanelekela, imithetho yenethiwekhi kunye nomthetho osebenzayo.
depin.ctaBody: Ukubuyela emuva komthombo, imidiya evikelwe nge-encryption nemisebenzi eqinisekisiwe kuza ngaphambi kwemivuzo ye-node yomphakathi.
depin.earlyAccessBody: I-node elula, esekwe kusiphequluli isivele iku-inthanethi ngezansi. I-node esindayo, ehlala ivuliwe yedeskithophu iyisimo esizayo esishiwo, esingatholakali okwamanje. Ukubamba iqhaza akukuvimbeli ukuthi uthole umvuzo.
depin.footerNote: Ukubamba iqhaza kwe-DePin kuyisevisi yokucontribute, akuwona umkhiqizo wokutshala izimali. Ukutholakala, ukufaneleka nemivuzo kungashintsha.
depin.heroBlurb: Contribute isitoreji esingeziwe, i-bandwidth kanye ne-compute ukusiza ukusingatha, ukuguqula nokuletha okuqukethwe kwe-DeHub.
depin.heroCaption: I-DeHub igcina ikhophi yomthombo. Ama-node omphakathi engeza izimpinda ezibuyelayo kanye nekhono lokulethwa lendawo.
depin.heroImageAlt: I-node ye-edge-compute encane exhunywe emakhaya kanye nezitudiyo zabaculi
depin.heroTitle: Izingxenyekazi zekhompyutha zakho. Inethiwekhi yemidiya ye-DeHub.
depin.nodesLeaveBody: Awekho oomashini bomphakathi abaphethe ikhophi eyodwa. Ukuhlolwa kwezempilo, izimpinda kanye nokubuyela emuva komthombo kugcina ukudlala kutholakala.
depin.privacyBody: Imidiya evikelwe ihlala i-encrypted kwingxenyekazi yomphakathi. Izikhiye zokudlala zinikezwa ngokwehlukana kubabukeli abagunyaziwe.
depin.runningCosts: Ukuqhuba i-node kusebenzisa ugesi, idatha ye-inthanethi kanye nempilo yezingxenyekazi zekhompyutha. Abasebenzisi bangase bangatholi lutho, futhi izindleko zabo zingase zidlule noma yimuphi umvuzo.
depin.safestWorkloadBody: I-DePin ingeze indlela yokulethwa ekhona ye-DeHub kuqala. Imisebenzi edinga kakhulu ilandela kuphela ngemuva kokuthi isiqinisekiso siqinisekisiwe.
depin.safestWorkloadTitle: Yakhiwe kusuka kumsebenzi ophephe kakhulu ngaphandle.
depin.threeJobsBody: Abasebenzisi bakhetha imikhawulo yabo yesitoreji, i-bandwidth kanye ne-compute. I-DeHub ihlela kuphela umsebenzi ongasingathwa ngokuphepha oomashini babo.
depin.transcodeBody: Omashini abafanelekayo aguqula ividiyo elayishwe yaba izinhlobo eziguquguqukayo. Konke okuphumayo kuhlolwa ngaphambi kokuthi kungasetshenziswa.
depin.transcodeImageAlt: Ikhaya lomdali elinikeza amandla e-GPU engeziwe
depin.verifiedWorkBody: Ukunikeza kulinganiswa ngamarisidi asayiniwe, ukuhlolwa kwezempilo, nokuqinisekiswa komphumela. Ukugcina kuphela akudali umvuzo.
depin.verifiedWorkTitle: Umsebenzi owusizo uyaqinisekiswa. Imivuzo ihlala iyaguquguquka.
depin.hostBody: Ama-node agcina izingxenye ezifihliwe noma ezibhalwe nge-content-addressed kusitoreji sendawo esilinganiselwe. Isitoreji sokuqala se-DeHub sihlala siyimithombo yeqiniso.
depin.deliverBody: Ozakwenu abaseduze babelana ngezingxenye zevidiyo ngenkathi indlela evamile yokudlulisa ihlala ilungele njengokubuyela emuva okuzenzakalelayo.
depin.originBody: Isizinda esihlala njalo nesitoreji sokudlulisa esibuyelayo
depin.offlineNodeBody: Kususwe ekuhambeni kuze kube yilapho ixhuma kabusha
depin.viewerBody: Usebenzisa ozakwenu lapho etholakala, isizinda lapho kudingeka
depin.protectedContentBody: Izimpawu zokubhalisa, ezizimele, nezokukhokha-ngokubuka zingagcinwa njenge-ciphertext. Abaqhubi be-node abatholi izikhiye zamalungelo ngokubamba idatha.
depin.publicContentBody: Ukuqashwa kuvimbela ukuhlola okungajwayelekile kwezifayela ezifakwe kusitoreji, kodwa imidiya yomphakathi ihlala ingabukwa nge-player yomphakathi ye-DeHub. Ngeke sisho okunye.
depin.operatorControlsBody: Abaqhubi bakhetha imingcele yediski, imingcele ye-bandwidth, amahora okusebenza, nezigaba zokuqukethwe zomphakathi ezifanelekayo. Izaziso zokususa zibangela ukuhlanza isitoreji.
depin.deliveryReceiptsBody: Amabhayithi aqinisekisiwe akhonza ezikhathini zokudlala zangempela.
depin.availabilityBody: Izinhlolovo zokuthola eziphumelelayo kanye nensizakalo ethembekile lapho inikeziwe.
depin.validOutputBody: Ukuguqulwa kufanele kudlule izinhlolovo zobuchwepheshe nezinganeno zekhwalithi.
depin.revenuePoolBody: Uma livuliwe, isabelo somvuzo sizobekwa kusuka emalini yesikhulumi ngemuva kokuthi i-epoch ivaleke.
depin.deliveryBody: Ukulethwa okubukhoma nokwevidiyo okusizwa ontanga nokushintsha okuzenzakalelayo.
depin.adaptiveVideoBody: Izinguqulo eziningi zokudlala okuthembekile kuzo zonke izivinini zokuxhuma.
depin.desktopNodesBody: Isitoreji esilinganiselwe, izilawuli zebhendi kanye nokutholakala okuqinisekisiwe.
depin.baseSettlementBody: Izimangalo ezixhaswe ngemali engenayo kuphela ngemuva kokubuyekezwa kokusebenza nokomthetho.
depin.faqOfflineQ: Kwenzekani lapho i-node yokusingatha ingaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi?
depin.faqOfflineA: Umxhumanisi uyayisusa ekuhambeni okusebenzayo. Enye i-replica idlala isigaba, noma ukudlala kubuyela kusitoreji somthombo we-DeHub ngenkathi amakhophi esikhundla ehlelelwe.
depin.faqCanOperatorSeeQ: Ingabe umsebenzisi we-node angabona okuqukethwe abakusingathayo?
depin.faqCanOperatorSeeA: Okuqukethwe okuvikelwe kugcinwa njengezigaba ezifihliwe futhi umasingathi akatholi okhiye bokudlala. Okuqukethwe komphakathi kuhlala kubonakala esidlangalaleni nge-DeHub ngokuklanywa.
depin.faqHowMuchA: Ayikho izinga eliqinisekile noma isibikezelo. Is contribution esiqinisekisiwe singathola isabelo sesikhwama somklomelo oxhaswe ngemali engenayo ngemuva kokuthi isikhathi sesivalo. Imiklomelo ayiqinisekisiwe, futhi izindleko zikagesi, zebhendi kanye nezehadiwe zingase zidlule noma yimuphi umklomelo.
depin.faqSoftwareAvailableA: Izinga elilula, elisekelwe kusiphequluli liyatholakala namuhla: ngena ngemvume bese ukhetha ekhasini, futhi ithebhu yakho evulekile iba yi-node ngenkathi ihlala ivulekile. I-node yedeskithophu esindayo, ehlala ivuliwe iyisiqondiso esizayo esishiwo - ayikho okwamanje.
depin.faqInstallNeededQ: Ngidinga ukufaka lutho yini i-node yesiphequluli?
depin.faqInstallNeededA: Cha. Isebenza ngokuphelele kuthebhu kusetshenziswa isitoreji sendawo sesiphequluli sakho. Ukuvala ithebhu kuyayeka i-node yakho; ayikho insizakalo yangemuva futhi ayikho i-install.
depin.appSignInBlurb: Ngena ngemvume ukuze ubone incwadi yakho yokubhalela ye-node: ongakugcinile, okwaqinisekiswa nokho uzuze kulesi sikhathi.
depin.appNodeBody: I-node isebenza kuthebhu yesiphequluli, hhayi kulolu hlelo lokusebenza. Vula i-DePin kuwebhu, ngena ngemvume nge-akhawunti le bese ukhetha. Incwadi yakho yokubhalela ivele lapha.

premium.familyTagline: I-Premium yakho nabantu abangafika kwabangu-5 obakhethayo.
premium.familyIncludes: Konke okukwi-Extra, kumasegundane afika kwangu-5. Isihlalo ngasinye sithola izabelo zaso.
premium.xlTagline: Zonke izinzuzo ngokuphelele. Ezitudiyo, ama-DAO, nabasebenzisi abanamandla.

premium.xlIncludes: Konke okukwi-Family, kwandiswe kwamasegundane afika ku-20 anama-AI aphezulu kakhulu namabhosti.
premium.stakeBlurb: Amazinga aphezulu angu-7 okubambayo avula i-DeHub Extra ngokuzenzakalelayo. Amahlelo aphezulu angu-4 avula i-DeHub Family. Akukho khadi elidingekayo.

premium.badgeDetail: Igama lomsebenzisi le-Plus gradient + 3 izingqikithi zephrofayela
premium.themesDetail: Khetha kwezingqikithi ezikhethiwe — kungekudala, yakha eyakho ngomakhi wezingqikithi olula olusekelwe kumbhalo

premium.followerInsightsDetail: Bona ukuthi yimaphi abalandeli abakuzibandakanya nawe kakhulu nokuthi kanjani — ukuthanda, ukuthunyelwa kabusha, ukuphawula, amathiphu
premium.boostDetail: Okuthunyelwe kwakho kubonwa ngabantu abaningi abafanele
premium.twentySeatsDetail: Letha lonke iqembu, i-studio noma i-DAO
premium.skyHighAiDetail: 5,000 Imilayezo ye-Assistant, 1,500 izithombe, 5 imizuzu yevidiyo ye-AI / ngenyanga
premium.unlimitedPeeksDetail: Bheka kuyo yonke imifudlana evaliwe, akukho mkhawulo wenyanga
premium.allThemesDetail: Yonke ingqikithi eyenziwe ngendlela oyifisayo, amathuba okuqala kumakhi wokwakha ingqikithi
premium.proFollowerInsightsDetail: Ukuhlukana okuphelele kwabalandeli bakho abaphezulu, izinhlobo zokuzibandakanya namathrendi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
premium.diveAdFreeBody: Susa konke okuthunyelwe okukhuthaziwe, zonke izibhanela zokuthuthukisa, zonke izikhala ezixhaswe ku-Explore. Abantu abadala nabadali obafikele bona.
premium.diveBackgroundBody: Vimba ifoni yakho, shintsha izinhlelo zokusebenza, yeqa amathebhu - ividiyo nomculo wakho kuyaqhubeka nokudlala. Phatha i-DeHub njengohlelo lokusebenza lwemidiya olunje.
premium.diveAiBody: Imilayezo engu-500 ye-Assistant, izithombe ezingama-AI eziyi-150, nevidiyo eyenziweyo yemizuzwana engu-20 njalo ngenyanga. Kwanele ukwakha, ukuthumela nokuthumela - akuyona into yokubuka.
premium.faqWhatIsAnAdA: Okuthunyelwe okukhuthaziwe kokuphakelayo kwakho, izibhanela zokuthuthukisa, nokubekwa okuxhaswe ku-Explore. I-Premium isusa konke lokho.
premium.faqSwitchPlansA: Yebo. Thuthukisa noma wehlise isigaba nganoma yisiphi isikhathi - ukukhokhelwa kuyalingana ngokuzenzakalelayo.
premium.faqFamilySeatsA: Umnikazi umema amagama abasebenzisi e-DeHub afinyelela ku-5. Ilungu ngalinye ligcina i-akhawunti yalo, amabheji, namakhota - akukho lutho oluhlanganisiwe noma olwabiwe.
premium.faqTopTierStakerA: Cha. Iziqu eziyi-7 eziphezulu zokubeka zithola i-DeHub Extra mahhala. Iziqu ezi-4 eziphezulu zithola i-DeHub Family mahhala. Khipha bese izinzuzo ziyanyamalala - phinda ubeke bese zibuyela.
premium.faqPayInDhbA: Izinkokhelo ngekhadi lapho kuqala. Ukukhokha ngamathokheni e-DeHub kuza kungekudala futhi kuzofaka isaphulelo.
premium.checkoutNotice: I-Checkout ivula i-dehub.io kusiphequluli sakho. Inkokhelo iphethwe yi-DeHub, hhayi i-Google Play.

premium.checkoutUnavailable: I-Checkout ayitholakali njengamanje. Sicela uzame futhi kamuva.

connect.title: Xhuma i-DeHub nomsizi wakho we-AI
connect.subtitle: Nika i-ChatGPT noma i-Claude ukufinyelela ku-DeHub — ukubuka okuthunyelwe, ukufunda izingxoxo zamazwana, ukusesha nokubheka amaphrofayela — ngokunamathisela i-URL engezansi kuzilungiselelo zezixhumi zomsizi wakho.
connect.agentTitle: Ufuna ukuthi ithumele, ivote futhi iphendule?
connect.agentBody: I-URL engenhla ingeyokufunda kuphela. Dala i-ejenti uthole eyakho i-URL yesixhumi enokhiye ngaphakathi — izinyathelo ezifanayo, kodwa umsizi uzokwazi ukuthumela, ukuphawula, ukuvota nokulandela njenge-ejenti yakho.
connect.chatgptDevMode: Vula imodi yonjiniyela kuzilungiselelo zezixhumi (funda isaziso sengozi esiboniswa lapho).
connect.chatgptComposer: Kumenyu ethi "+" yebhokisi lengxoxo, vula imodi yonjiniyela.
connect.chatgptAddSources: Khetha Engeza imithombo, bese Xhuma okuningi.
connect.nameAndPaste: Qamba isixhumi ngokuthi "DeHub" bese unamathisela i-URL ye-MCP engenhla.
connect.askToUse: Cela i-{{app}} ukuthi isebenzise i-DeHub — isibonelo: "Ngikhombise okuthunyelwe okudumile ku-DeHub."
connect.claudeEnable: Vula isixhumi ebhokisini lengxoxo le-Claude, bese uyicela ukuthi isebenzise i-DeHub.
connect.otherClients: Noma iyiphi enye iklayenti esebenza ne-MCP isebenza ngendlela efanayo — engeza iseva ye-MCP yangokwezifiso bese unamathisela i-URL engenhla.
connect.guideIntro: I-DeHub iyatholakala njengesixhumi sendabuko se-{{app}}. Yivule kanye bese ubuza i-{{app}} ngokuthunyelwe, abadali nezitayela ze-DeHub — ngqo engxoxweni.
connect.step1Body: Thepha inkinobho engenhla. I-{{app}} izovuleka ngqo esixhumini se-DeHub ku-Izilungiselelo → Izixhumi.
connect.step2Body: Vula i-DeHub bese uvumela ukufinyelela. I-{{app}} izokwazi ukufunda okuthunyelwe komphakathi, amaphrofayela nezihloko ezidumile ze-DeHub.
connect.step3Body: Vula ingxoxo entsha bese ushaya i-DeHub emyalweni wakho — i-{{app}} ibiza isixhumi ngokuzenzakalelayo.
connect.prompt1: Fingqa okuthunyelwe oku-10 okudume kakhulu ku-DeHub njengamanje.
connect.prompt2: Thola okuthunyelwe ku-DeHub mayelana ne-Bitcoin emahoreni angu-24 edlule bese unginika isifinyezo.
connect.prompt3: Bheka iphrofayela ye-DeHub @satoshi bese ungitshela ukuthi bathumeleni kuleli sonto.
connect.faqFreeA: Yebo. Isixhumi simahhala. Uhlelo lwakho lwe-{{app}} kufanele lusekele izixhumi.
connect.faqWhatA: Nge-MCP singabuka okuthunyelwe komphakathi kwe-DeHub, sisesha izihloko futhi sibheke amaphrofayela abadali. Asithumeli egameni lakho.
connect.chatgptFaqAccount: Ayikho i-akhawunti edingekayo ukuze ufunde okusunguliwe komphakathi ngesixhumi. I-akhawunti ye-DeHub iyadingeka kuphela uma ufuna ukuphosta, ukusikisela noma ukubamba amathokheni e-DeHub.
connect.claudeFaqAccount: Cha. Ukufunda okusunguliwe komphakathi kusebenza ngaphandle kwe-akhawunti. Udinga kuphela i-akhawunti ye-DeHub ukuze uphoste, ucebise noma ubambe amathokheni e-DeHub.

credits.topUpPending: Okuthe xaxa kwakho kuyaqinisekisa. Izovela kubhalansi yakho maduzane.
credits.subscriptionTokensValueNote: Amathokheni okubhalisa anenani lawo lamadola. Uma inani lethokheni lihamba ngaphambi kokulisebenzisa uzobona amathokheni amaningi noma ambalwa, kodwa ngaso sonke isikhathi bathenga inani elifanayo lesizukulwane se-AI. Awukwazi ukuhoxiswa, ukuthunyelwa noma ukudayiswa.

accountDeletion.title: Sula Ikhawundi
accountDeletion.description: Susa i-akhawunti yakho nedatha yakho unomphela
accountDeletion.warning: Lokhu kudilitha unomphela iphrofayili yakho ye-DeHub, amaphosti, amakhomenti, imilayezo kanye ne-backup ye-wallet egciniwe. Gcina imininingwane yakho yokubuyisela isikhwama bese uhambisa noma yiziphi izimpahla kuqala. Ukuthengiselana kwe-blockchain yomphakathi namarekhodi enkokhelo adingekayo ngokomthetho awakwazi ukususwa. Iphrofayili yakho ifihliwe ngokushesha; ukudilitha kuphothulwa zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu-30. Lokhu akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.
accountDeletion.receipt: Isicelo sakho sokususa sigciniwe. Iphrofayili yakho ifihliwe futhi i-akhawunti yakho izodilithwa unomphela zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu-30. Ukungena ngemvume akukwazi ukukhansela lesi sicelo.
accountDeletion.error: Ayikwazanga ukuthumela isicelo sakho sokususa. I-akhawunti yakho ayikaqinisekiswa ukuthi isusiwe. Sicela uzame futhi.
accountDeletion.signIn: Ngena ngemvume ukuze ususe i-akhawunti yakho
accountDeletion.acknowledge: Ngilondoloze imininingwane yami yokubuyisela isikhwama semali futhi ngiyaqonda ukuthi ukudilitha akupheli.

signIn.body: Le app izothola ikheli lakho lesikhwama se-DeHub nethokheni yokungena ngemvume esebenza kuphela kule app. Ngeke ikwazi ukungena esikhwameni sakho semali, izimali zakho noma i-akhawunti yakho ye-DeHub.

store.title: Ama-app
store.intro: Ama-app amancane akhelwe i-DeHub yinoma ubani. Ivuleka ngaphakathi kwe-DeHub, usuvele ungene ngemvume, futhi yonke i-app ibonisa ikheli layo lewebhu langempela.
store.emptyBody: Ama-app okuqala ayahlolwa. Yakha eyodwa futhi kungaba lapha.

updateGate.title: Buyekeza i-DeHub
updateGate.recommendedBody: Kukhona inguqulo entsha ye-DeHub enokulungiswa okubalulekile kwezokuphepha. Buyekeza ukuze i-akhawunti yakho ihlale ivikelekile.
updateGate.requiredBody: Le nguqulo ye-DeHub ayisasekelwa. Buyekeza ukuze uqhubeke usebenzisa i-akhawunti yakho.

walletBackup.rowDesc: Bona amagama akho angu-12 noma ukhiye wangasese
walletBackup.offerBody: Amagama angu-12 abuyisa isikhwama sakho semali uma ulahlekelwa ifoni noma iphasiwedi. Kuthatha imizuzwana engu-30.
walletBackup.offerBodyDeviceOnly: Isikhwama sakho semali sihlala kuphela kule foni. Ngaphandle kwala mazwi, ucingo olulahlekile lusho isikhwama semali esilahlekile.

walletBackup.warnPaper: Zibhale ephepheni, hhayi esithombeni seskrini noma ku-app yamanothi.
walletBackup.passwordToShowWords: Faka iphasiwedi yakho ye-wallet ukuze ubonise amagama akho angu-12.
walletBackup.reminderBody: Buyela emuva esikhwameni sakho semali — amagama angu-12 ayibuyisayo uma ulahlekelwa ifoni yakho.

controls.title: Izilawuli ezisheshayo
controls.intro: Phakathi nokusakaza. Inkinobho ngayinye ibamba wonke umuntu obukayo, ku-app naku-OBS, uze uyibuyisele emuva.
controls.alertsPausedHint: Asikho isipho, landela noma ulawule imiyalezo esikrinini. Amakhawunta, imigomo nebhokisi lengxoxo kuyaqhubeka.

liveStudio.title: I-Live Studio
liveStudio.subtitle: Ama-alerts kanye ne-widgets para sa okusakaza kwakho
liveStudio.intro: Konke okwengeza lapha kuvela phezu kokusakaza kwakho kubo bonke ababhali ku-app ye-DeHub — noma ngabe usakaza kusuka ku-foni yakho, ibrowser, i-capture card noma i-encoder.
liveStudio.settingsLinkBody: I-tip alerts, izinjongo nokuningi ngaphezu kokusakaza kwakho, kusetha ku-Live Studio.
liveStudio.layoutHintPhone: Hudula i-widget ukuze uyisuse, bese ushintsha usayizi wayo ezilungiselelweni zayo. Okusakaza kwe-landscape kanye ne-portrait ngakunye kugcina ukulandela kwabo.
liveStudio.empty: Azikho ama-widgets okwamanje. Engeza i-tip alert noma injongo ukuze uqale.
liveStudio.testHint: Ama-alerts okulinga adlala lapha kuphela futhi akukho enye indawo. Ababhali abakaze babone.
liveStudio.testMessage: Nansi indlela i-tip message ebukeka ngayo ku-stream yakho
liveStudio.testFailed: Leyo alert yokulinga ayithumeli. Zama futhi emomenti.
liveStudio.saved: Igcinwe. Okusakaza kwakho kubonisa ukulandela okusha ngokushesha.
liveStudio.saveFailed: Ayikwazanga ukugcina. Hlola ukuxhumana kwakho bese uzama futhi.
liveStudio.loadFailed: Ayikwazanga ukuhlela ama-widgets akho. Buya ngemuva bese uzama futhi.

obs.title: Sebenzisa nge-OBS
obs.inAppHint: I-app yesibukeli ngasinye iyazidonsela phezu kokusakaza kwakho. Isebenza ngocingo lwakho, ibhrawuza, ikhadi lokuthwebula noma i-OBS, futhi akubizi lutho.
obs.inVideoHint: I-OBS iyayishisa esithombeni sakho, ngakho-ke isendaweni yakho yokuphindaphinda futhi noma kuphi lapho umfudlana wakho ubukwa khona.
obs.warnDoubles: I-OBS yakho ixhunyiwe, kodwa amawijethi akho nawo asethelwe ukuvela ku-app ye-DeHub, ngakho ababukeli babona yonke imiyalezo kabili.
obs.warnNoObs: Ayikho i-OBS overlay exhunyiwe njengamanje. Kuze kube yilapho ufaka umthombo webhrawuza, ababukeli ngeke babone amawijethi akho.
obs.step1: Ku-OBS, faka umthombo weBhrawuza bese unamathisela le linki.
obs.step2: Setha ububanzi bube ngu-1920 futhi ubude bube ngu-1080, noma u-1080 ungakedluli u-1920 ukuze ube nomfudlana oqondile.
obs.step3: Ngemva kokubuyekezwa, chofoza kwesokudla umthombo bese ukhetha okuthi Vuselela isilondolozi sekhasi lamanje.
obs.rotateConfirm: Yenza ilinki entsha? Elidala liyayeka ukusebenza ngaso leso sikhathi, ngakho kuzodingeka unamathisele elisha ukuze ULITHANDE.
obs.rotateFailed: Ayikwazanga ukwenza ilinki entsha. Zama futhi ngomzuzwana.

rules.wheelHint: Phakathi kuka-2 no-12. I-DeHub ikhetha lapho isondo limile khona, ukuze wonke umuntu obukayo abone umphumela ofanayo. Sebenzisa i-{result} kumyalezo, ukufunda ngokuzwakalayo noma isenzo sokuxoxa ukuze uyiqambe.
rules.title: Imithetho
rules.intro: Lapho kwenzeka okuthile ku-stream yakho, i-DeHub yenza lokho okukhethe: ikhombisa isikhazo, idlale umsindo, ifunde okuthile ngaphakathi, ifake ekusulwaneni kwakho noma itshele i-Discord yakho.
rules.loadFailed: Imithetho yakho ayikwazanga ukuloada. Vuselela ikhasi ukuze uzame futhi.
rules.empty: Ayikho imithetho okwamanje. Engeza enye ukuze uphendule amathiphu, ukubalandela noma amakomanzi ekusulwaneni.
rules.saved: Imithetho igcinwe. Ibaleka ku-tip, follow noma umyalezo wakho olandelayo.
rules.testFailed: Lokhu kuhlola akuqedile. Zama futhi emomenti.
rules.needsAlertWidget: Eminye imithetho ikhombisa isikhazo. Engeza i-Rule alerts widget ukuze ibe nendawo yokuvela.

rules.blockedWordsHint: Hlukanisa ngokhoma. Imilayezo equkethe ayibalwa futhi ayikho nokubalwa ngaphakathi.

rules.chatHint: Kuthunyelwe kusuka ku-akhawunti yakho engxoxweni yokusakaza kwakho. Ayikwazi ukuphinda umyalezo wesibukeli.
rules.webhookHint: I-Discord noma i-Slack webhook, noma yiliphi ikheli le-https elamukela IPHOSTI.

polls.title: Amavoti
polls.intro: Buza abantu ababukela ukusakaza kwakho umbuzo. Baphendula ngenkinobho ku-app ye-DeHub, noma ngokuthayipha okuthi {{command}} nenombolo yenketho engxoxweni.
polls.question: Umbuzo
polls.started: Ukuvota kwakho kuvuliwe. Ababukeli bangavota manje.
polls.notLive: Iya bukhoma kuqala. Ukuvota kuyaqhubeka ekusakazeni okusakazayo njengamanje.
polls.widgetHint: Ibonisa inhlolovo yakho ebukhoma. Kubabukeli be-app ye-DeHub thepha inketho yokuvota; ku-OBS itshela abantu ukuthi bathayiphe i-{{command}} nenombolo engxoxweni.

moderation.title: Ukulinganisela ingxoxo
moderation.intro: Imithetho yengxoxo ngaphansi kwakho konke ukusakaza kwakho. Abalokothi bafinyelele engxoxweni eyinhloko ye-DeHub: othile omvimbelayo lapha usengakhuluma kwenye indawo.
moderation.loadFailed: Amasethingi akho okulinganisela awakwazanga ukulayishwa. Vuselela ikhasi ukuze uzame futhi.
moderation.slowModeHint: Isikhathi esithile umuntu obukela alinde phakathi kwemilayezo. Wena nabahleli bakho akusoze nilibale.
moderation.bannedWordsHint: Hlukanisa nezimagqabhagqabha. Ukupela igama ngohlamvu akuzungezi.

subathon.intro: Ukubalwa kokusakazwa kwakho. Isipho ngasinye esikhokhelwayo, landela futhi ubhalisele sinezela isikhathi, ukuze igumbi likugcine uphila.

points.title: Ababukeli abathembekile
points.intro: Ababukeli bathola iphuzu ngomzuzu ngamunye abakubukayo kanye nelilodwa ngomzuzu ngamunye we-DHB engu-100 abawunikezayo. Ingxoxo nokusabela akuzuzisi lutho, ngakho amaphuzu awakwazi ukulinywa.
points.empty: Awekho amaphuzu okwamanje. Akhula njengoba abantu bebuka futhi bezipho.
points.widgetHint: Faka iwijethi yababukeli abathembekile ukuze ubonise lolu hlu ekusakazeni.
